store.name: World of Anterra
store.short: The prophecy foretold your coming, Traveller, but are you here to save Anterra or yourself? Explore an expansive living world, with thriving towns, wild animals, and monster filled dungeons. Discover secrets, lore and mysteries, and uncover the truth about the Eye to become Anterra's Champion.
store.about:
100% human made. 
 World of Anterra is a handcrafted open-world role playing adventure; featuring a non-linear story and quests, deep progression systems, fast and exciting grid-based combat, and rich lore, all wrapped in a satisfying and tactile interface.

 Uncover the mysteries of Anterra by asking questions, interacting with the environment, reading books and exploring the world. Learn about the history of magic, and the ancient races. Sneak into crypts, caves and houses and discover secrets hidden in containers or behind breakable objects.

 Anterra is a dangerous and unpredictable world, beset by unstable magics, dangerous factions, and tortured creatures... but you will find moments of solitude and comfort amidst the chaos. Rest in friendly taverns, set up camps to sleep the darkness away, or take a moment to sit on a log and enjoy the sights and sounds of a living world.

 Combat blends quick-time actions with grid-based strategy. The UI is streamlined so simple encounters can be blasted through with ease. While skill and strategy is needed to conquer the game's more challenging foes; combining skill-based mechanics for attacking and defending, with special abilities, magic spells, crafted items, and strategic movement.

 World of Anterra blends hand-animated assets with player customization. Build your party members with a vast array of items and gear and see it all come to life with a custom animation layering system. This system also applies to NPCs and creatures creating a truly diverse and unique experience.

 World of Anterra comes to life with a custom...

store.name: Bodycam
store.short: Bodycam is the first tactical multiplayer FPS with a true body-camera view in Unreal Engine 5. Close-quarters combats feel raw and loud. Every angle, callout, and bullet matters. Play Deathmatch, Team Deathmatch, and Wingman on photoreal maps where teamplay, tactics, and clutch skill are key.
store.about:
SEE COMBAT THROUGH THE LENS 
 Bodycam is the first ultra-realistic multiplayer FPS built to recreate the intensity of real combat. Experience tactical firefights through the lens of a body camera, where every angle you hold, every decision you make, and every bullet you fire can decide the outcome. Miss a check, and you pay for it. No crosshair. No ammo counter. No HUD. Countless hours were spent studying real footage, optics, camera movement, compression, exposure, sound behavior, and combat situations to push realism as far as possible. 

 THE TRUE FIRST-PERSON FEEL 
 Unlike traditional FPS games , where the camera drives the entire experience and floating hands are simply attached to your screen , Bodycam takes a completely different approach.

 Your arms, torso, legs and weapon are all physically connected. On top of this, we developed our True Body technology, making every movement feel smoother, more instinctive and more natural. It takes a little time to adapt at first , but once it clicks, your weapon becomes an extension of your body and the line between you and the operator begins to disappear. 

 Once you've experienced combat this way, there's no going back. 

 WEAPONS THAT FEEL REAL 
 Every reload is driven by a dynamic animation system with separate calm and stressed states. Under pressure, your character can make realistic mistakes , rush movements and struggle to complete a reload, just like a real person would. Instead of playing the same animation every time, we created dozens of unique reload variations and mistakes, making every reload feel different.

...

store.name: Alchedoom
store.short: A first-person alchemy roguelite. Wake in a dark lord's cell. Refine pills as tribute to survive. Handle pills, add ingredients, use fire. Success, damage or ruin: decide when to stop. Combine relics, catalysts and fire seeds to bend the odds. Face new trials daily. Will you live to escape?
store.about:
Alchedoom is a first-person alchemy roguelite. You wake up locked in a dark lord's alchemy chamber, where elixirs are your daily tribute. Pick them up, add ingredients and work the fire. Watch a humble pill grow more valuable with every firing—then decide whether to take it out or risk one more.

 Enter Trance. Keep the fire going.
 Fill your Focus and the next firing triggers Trance. Make those few seconds count: fire again and again as your elixir climbs in tier and value. Trance prevents Ruin, but not Damage. Outside it, keep a close eye on the odds above the cauldron. The next firing could pay off—or knock your prized elixir down a tier, or destroy it altogether.

 One pill, four paths
 Origin, Herbal, Beast and Exotic: four paths produce very different elixirs. Choose a catalyst, then refine one firing at a time. Leaves, beastly forms and strange objects change with each tier, each with its own trails of light. Once you're done, pick up your creation and turn it around. See what this batch has become.

 Open the chest. Pick it up. Put it in.
 Open the Treasure Chest, turn it around and take the catalysts, talismans and powders you need from its compartments. Drop them into the cauldron yourself. A Warding Talisman saves an elixir from Ruin once; Spirit-Gathering Powder improves your chance of Great Success; catalysts determine its growth path. Everything has a use, and everything runs out. Leave something for the next batch.

 Trade a good elixir for a better build
 Feed an elixir into the Exchange to buy a Relic, then place it on your rack to activate it. Some add...

store.name: Underkeep
store.short: Explore a dangerous fantasy world in this role-playing dungeon crawler with tactical, turn-based combat. Assemble a party of adventurers, upgrade your gear, and explore a fully handcrafted world.
store.about:
DESCEND. EXPLORE. SURVIVE. 
 Underkeep is a loving tribute to the role-playing classics of the 90s with turn-based combat and grid-based movement, bringing the best of old-school dungeon crawlers to life in a modern setting with hand-drawn graphics and a crafted world.

 Underkeep brings back the spirit of classic dungeon crawlers: grid movement, slow tension and tactical combat. At the same time it plays clean and responsive thanks to modern controls, clear visuals and thoughtful conveniences that remove the old frustrations without losing the heart.

 Gather your party, venture into hand-built dungeons, speak with peculiar locals, discover hidden passages, solve ancient puzzles and face encounters where planning matters as much as courage.

 FORGED PARTY 
 Pick four adventurers whose strengths and flaws define how you survive. Synergy is everything: a good team deepens your strategy, a bad one seals your grave.

 LIVING DUNGEONS 
 Every corridor is handmade, every room hides intent. Expect strange rituals, lingering spirits, abandoned camps, cryptic symbols and choices that echo deeper than you expect.

 TACTICAL COMBAT 
 Turn-based battles reward those who plan, control space and manage stamina & mana wisely. The bold are rewarded. The careless are punished.

 HIDDEN SECRETS 
 Hidden alcoves, fake walls, optional bosses and puzzles that fit the world instead of breaking immersion.

 MODERN COMFORT 
 Smooth controls and clear feedback preserve the flow of exploration without sacrificing tension.

 PERSONAL MAP 
 A built-in automap with custom markers keeps track of...

store.name: The Bornless
store.short: Welcome to The Bornless, an action horror FPS. Face off against other players, summon demons, and build factions in a Lovecraftian world. Use Black Magick, acquire powerful weapons, upgrade your Safehouse, and strategize to survive.
store.about:
Welcome, stranger! 
 You've arrived at Farmouth Island, a foreboding stretch of wilderness off the Massachusetts coast. Here lies the heart of The Bornless, an action horror FPS where the veil between reality and the abyss is perilously thin. Face off against other players, play as demons, and wield Black Magick in a battle for survival and supremacy. 

 SURVIVAL HORROR EXTRACTION 
 Step into Ritual Mode, a relentless PvPvE survival horror extraction that tests your resilience against demonic forces and rival players. Begin your harrowing journey in an isolated cabin and navigate through the dense, mist-shrouded forests of Farmouth Island. Collect crucial resources, tackle mysterious objectives, and survive the terror that lurks around every corner. 

 GAMEPLAY OVERVIEW 
 Phase 1: Loot and Explore - Start in a secluded cabin with your duo partner, armed with your standard loadout or the spoils from previous missions. Venture through haunting landscapes, fight for Sigils, battle cultists and demons to complete quests, and gather valuable items. 

 Phase 2: The Ritual - Use Incense to activate ancient ritual sites known as Gates, summoning events yield rare Sigils necessary for the final confrontation. Each completed ritual exposes you to danger, highlighting your location to rival players
 Phase 3: Hunt or Be Hunted - Complete the ritual, invoke the demon, and hunt the remaining players, who must find an extraction point before the time runs out to escape the island.

 UNITE AND SURVIVE 
 Engage directly in the chaos of The Bornless with a unique blend of PvP and PvE...

store.name: SMITE 2
store.short: Become a god and wage war in SMITE 2, the free-to-play Unreal Engine 5-powered sequel to the legendary third-person action MOBA. If you love challenging competition, intense action, ability-driven combat, rewarding teamwork, or godly mythology, you’ll see why 40+ million players love SMITE.
store.about:
Fight as a God 

 Choose your God from across mythology and wield unique godly abilities. Hurl bolts of lightning as Zeus, master the arcane powers of death as Anubis, or backstab your foes as Loki.

 The Third-Person Action MOBA 

 No other game offers combat that feels like your favorite hero shooter, crossed with the deep strategy you can only find in a 5v5 MOBA. Feel the impact of every shot, sneak up on enemies, and combo abilities with teammates to take down the enemy Titan in Conquest mode, or defeat waves of minions and enemy Gods to secure victory in Arena mode.

 Play Anywhere, With Anyone 

 SMITE 2 features full cross-play and cross-progression, so you can play with friends regardless of platform and take your unlocks with you.

 SMITE, Reforged 

 More than 40 million players have enjoyed SMITE. Now the next generation of action MOBA begins, with immersive visuals powered by Unreal Engine 5, more impactful combat, and new creative gameplay options like playstyle-redefining Aspects to shape the game in your own way.

 Minutes to Learn, a Lifetime to Master 

 SMITE 2 is the easiest MOBA to start playing, with features like auto-build and auto-level so you focus on fighting. But the full depth of MOBA gameplay awaits, letting you find your own path to victory across item building, map control, tactical brilliance, or simply outplaying your foes. Compete in a variety of game modes with the right complexity for your mood: The deathmatch-like 5v5 Arena mode, 3v3 single-lane Joust, 5v5 random character Assault, the classic 5v5 three-lane Conquest, and Ranked...

store.name: Enginefall
store.short: Session based survival where players upgrade and live aboard their own personal trains. Team up with friends, make new ones or go solo. Board colossal Titan Trains to fight, build, craft, gather and steal much needed resources. Fortify and stock your personal train fortress. Will you survive?
store.about:
Enginefall is a new type of crafting multiplayer shooter. Board a colossal megatrain with your crew at the back, scavenge and build compact makeshift bases, push forward for better gear, then retreat to your Dagger shuttle to grow stronger and climb the train classes.

 Enginefall takes place entirely on colossal moving trains. From cramped tail slums to lavish first-class cars and guarded engine rooms, every carriage is a living space to loot, fight over, turn into a base, or eventually claim as part of your own rolling home as you climb from tailie to conductor.

 Enginefall is built around human opponents and allies. Raid trains with friends, defend your makeshift bases, and clash with other players over key routes and resources, with every encounter having the potential to flip from cooperation to conflict in a heartbeat.

 Scavenge as you go and turn whatever you find into useful gear, armor, and structures. Throw together compact bases for respawns and storage, craft upgraded gear as you move up the train, and adjust your loadout on the fly instead of sticking to a single pre-set build.

 Turn your Dagger shuttle from a rust bucket to a sleek assault craft, and eventually take control of a fully player-owned Marauder train. Expand from a single carriage into a chain of workshops, bunk rooms, and gun decks, then keep it supplied by hitting Titan trains and defending your moving fortress from rival conductors with your crew beside you.

store.name: Clockwork Revolution
store.short: CHANGE THE PAST. CONTROL THE FUTURE. Alter the course of history and rewrite the future in this steampunk first-person RPG.
store.about:
Wield the power of an incredible device to travel back in time, changing the past and rewriting the future of the city you call home: the vibrant steampunk metropolis of Avalon.

 In this immersive RPG, you'll step into the shoes of Morgan Vanette, a fully customizable player-character and member of the Rotten Row Hooligans. Travel between past and present as you battle the ruthless Lady Ironwood, who has been manipulating time to keep the working class struggling while amassing immense wealth and power.

 Your interactions and choices will have a butterfly effect on the deep, narrative-driven world, shaping characters and events in unexpected ways.

 With the power of time in your hands, how will you fight your way through Avalon’s history and redefine its future?

 CONTROL YOUR JOURNEY, YOUR WAY
 Create your character from the ground up and specialize with gear, attributes, and skills. Your choices can let you hack hostile automaton robots, craft intricate steampunk weapons and gadgets, and control time itself.

 A WONDROUS STEAMPUNK WORLD

 HOW TO PLAY CLUE/CLUEDO: 
 Three cards are dealt face-down and set aside – this is the solution to the crime!

 Everyone is dealt three Clue Cards. These are automatically crossed off your clue sheet, as they can’t be part of the solution. 

 Roll the dice and move around the board. 

 When you enter a room, you can make a suggestion – select who you think the murderer is, what weapon they used and where the crime happened. 

 Other players will then aim to disprove your suggestion; if one of your suggestions matches a card in their hand, they show you that card to disprove it.

However, some curious humans discovered how to harness qi for themselves, transforming it into elemental powers—fire, water, earth, metal, and wood. These practitioners became known as Elemancers. The Celestials were outraged, viewing this as a misuse of what was rightfully theirs. To send a message, they launched a swift and brutal assault on the Zhou Kingdom, the mightiest in the land. In one night, the king and many Elemancers were hunted down and slaughtered. This day became infamously known as the God Fall.

You play as Cheng, whose family was brutally slain by the Celestials during the God Fall. Now, you must embark on a quest to save your people and avenge your loved ones.

To achieve this, you will learn to harness and enhance your elemental powers, acquire new skills from ancient scrolls and elemental masters, and refine the flow of qi within you. With dedication, you will gain the power to challenge even the mightiest Celestials.

In this world, elemental powers interact dynamically: fire consumes wood, water extinguishes fire, steam rises from boiling water, and earth can obstruct. Your approach to utilizing these elemental interactions in battle is entirely up to you!

Launch your aviation Career wherever you choose in the world. Gain experience, build your reputation, and complete certifications to gain access to authentic aviation activities ranging from Medevac, Remote Cargo Ops, Aerial Firefighting, Search & Rescue and more, all the way to becoming an Airline Passenger Transport Pilot. Set out on a truly global aviation adventure with virtually unlimited missions across the planet.

Compete against other pilots in the all-new Challenge League mode or hone your skills in dozens of Activities ranging from exciting Rally Races and Precision Landings to Low-Altitude challenges and more. Fly head-to-head in the iconic Red Bull Air Races and the legendary Reno Air Races, including the new Roswell courses.

Be a World Photographer and travel across our beautiful planet to capture awe-inspiring natural vistas, visit famous landmarks, and record these adventures with pictures in your travel book. Unique photo challenges test your creative eye along with your piloting skills while you strive to capture the perfect moment.

 Advanced Simulation 
Enhanced physics system allows 10,000+ rigid-body surfaces that enable the simulation of any shape of aircraft. Soft body physics supports cloth, ropes, balloons, and more. Improved ground and water handling further enhance realism.

New, highly accurate aircraft systems including electrical, pneumatic, fuel and hydraulic systems, payload and passenger systems, and avionics like the Universal UNS-1 FMS and Primus Epic 2. Preflight inspections and walkaround checks add to immersion.
...

store.name: POPUCOM
store.short: Venture together with your friends on an unknown planet. Use color switching, match-3 shooting, and artifact powers to overcome challenges and keep advancing. What lies ahead of you is an adventure filled with wonder, hope, and much more to discover!
store.about:
POPUCOM is a multiplayer co-op platform adventure game. As an adventurer, you are summoned to an unknown planet to embark on an exoplanet adventure with your friends. You will face various enemies and use engaging items and techniques to eliminate threats and restore the world to its former glory.

 Work together with your friends to take on a variety of challenges. Effective cooperation and strong teamwork are the only ways forward. Whether it's facing powerful enemies or tackling complex puzzles, you'll need to work together to triumph!

 Color plays a crucial role in this fantastical world. It is key to everything from puzzle solving to combat. You'll need to switch colors to activate mechanisms and solve puzzles, and shoot Pomu gel in different colors to change the surroundings and impact enemies. Master the techniques of color switching and match-3 shooting to overcome puzzles and defeat enemies!

 During the journey, you will acquire items known as super artifacts. Examples of these wondrous artifacts include Rollo the Bomb, Captain Kitty, Barrier Bot, and Power Kid. Each of them grants you a unique ability that helps remove obstacles and solve puzzles in your adventure.

 The adventure isn't just about combat; it's also about showcasing your style! Pick from a selection of gear and cosmetics in the Closet and combine them to create your unique looks. Then you can set off on the journey in your personalized style!

 In addition to the exciting battles and engaging puzzles, the game includes a number of enjoyable mini-games. Head to the in-game arcade room for some...

store.name: The Legend of California
store.short: The Legend of California is an open world, action-survival shooter set on the mythical Island of California during the gold rush era. Explore a vast, untamed frontier and forge your legacy alone or with friends.
store.about:
The Legend of California is a  multiplayer, action-survival FPS set on the Island of California during the gold rush era. 

 Explore, gather, craft, build, hunt, and fight your way across a vast untamed frontier. Whether you choose to travel alone or work together with friends, your mission on this mythical island is not just to survive, but thrive.

 Stay strong, stake your claim, and become the true Legend of California. 

 Discover an expansive, ever-changing open world inspired by the gold rush era that features distinct biomes, challenging PvE encounters, and iconic California landmarks 

 Master FPS combat that rewards precision and skill—whether you’re hunting wildlife to stay alive, taking down hostile encampments for some quick coin, or defending your territory against enemy players in optional PvP 

 Leverage robust gathering and crafting systems to transform the Californian wilderness into everything you need to survive, from weapons for protection and tools for expansion to delicious meals to stay fed and ready 

 Establish and expand your own ranch ; build a mine, add stables, and unlock powerful new crafting stations to further customize your slice of the wild 

 Play online on persistent multiplayer servers where you can forge your legacy solo or form a company with up to three other players, sharing resources, buildings, progress, and more

store.name: One-armed robber
store.short: One-armed robber is a chaotic first-person heist game that centers around a uniquely challenging premise. Players take the role of a determined robber equipped with only one arm, tasked with pulling off daring heists on banks, shops, and various establishments.
store.about:
Experience the challenge of robbing banks, but now with only one arm! Grab a friend and you'll have two arms in total.

Unlock and buy new guns, which can be customized to fit your playstyle. If you are trying to go stealth, the optimal choice might be a suppressor, but if you're going loud, damage and bullets is all that matters, so put on an extended mag and get going!

Each heist is suited for any playstyle, whether you want to sneak in and take out guards quietly, or you go in guns blazing shooting everthing in your sight until you reach the vault, the choice is yours. 

As you become a more experienced robber new tools will be unlocked, which will make it easier for you to complete the heists. Each tool has a special purpose, and unique tools make it possible to complete heists in new ways you couldn't do before. 

Whether you go loud or stealth, once you are in the vault, the objective is the same: Gather as much loot as possible, and get out alive!
If you can't fit all the loot in the vault in your duffel bag, you can either run back to the truck and get a new one, or get your friends to help you carry out everything!

store.name: Goodbye Seoul
store.short: Six months remain before an asteroid hits Earth. And a new leaf is about to turn. A narrative puzzle adventure unfolds in a bleak yet beautiful Seoul. Will you uncover the truth in time?
store.about:
As news of an impending asteroid strike looms over Earth, the once bustling city of Seoul has turned into a wasteland.
 Play as Rion, a student who ventures into the ruined city, trailing the leads for what might be humanity's last thread of hope—a covert evacuation program destined for outer space.
 Follow Rion's journey across a bleak yet beautiful Seoul in this story-rich puzzle platformer.
 Make use of your surroundings to solve puzzles, and find hidden clues that will help piece together the full picture of the covert project.
 But beware, as this city is not a welcoming place.
 Between crumbling ruins and hostile survivors, every step Rion takes is rife with danger.

 The planet has only six months before it meets its end. Will you uncover the truth in time?

 With six months left until the impact, hope was the first to fall. 

 Uncover the truth behind the secret space evacutation project. 

 Face the doubts within, and find a purpose to keep on living. 

 Team up with desperate survivors and unlikely allies as you explore Seoul. 

 Use the environment to avoid direct confrontation. 
 Observe, think, and survive—every detail is part of the puzzle.

store.name: KINGDOM HEARTS -HD 1.5+2.5 ReMIX-
store.short: KINGDOM HEARTS -HD 1.5+2.5 ReMIX- is an HD remastered collection of 6 unforgettable KINGDOM HEARTS experiences. Take up your Keyblade to save the Disney worlds from darkness.
store.about:
KINGDOM HEARTS -HD 1.5+2.5 ReMIX- is an essential collection of the first six stories in the KINGDOM HEARTS series, a collaboration between Disney and SQUARE ENIX. Wield the legendary Keyblade and unlock the true power of friendship as you explore Disney worlds and defend them from darkness.

 KINGDOM HEARTS FINAL MIX

 KINGDOM HEARTS Re:Chain of Memories

 KINGDOM HEARTS II FINAL MIX

 KINGDOM HEARTS 358/2 Days (HD cutscene compilation)

 KINGDOM HEARTS Birth by Sleep FINAL MIX

 KINGDOM HEARTS Re:coded (HD cutscene compilation)

Enhanced backgrounds make this collection more stunning than ever before. Start your KINGDOM HEARTS journey now!

This game is available in two versions: Japanese and International.
Select your preferred language via the Steam launcher by right-clicking the title, then selecting "Properties" followed by "General".

NOTICE: Save data cannot be transferred between the Japanese and International versions.

store.name: Burning Sword: Death Sun
store.short: Burning Sword: Death Sun is a wuxia action game set in 12th century China. Play as Zhang Yixiang, cast down by the Elder of the Northern Mountain, and carve a bloody path back to him. Hardcore combat, epic boss battles, roguelite progression, and an arena built for high scores.
store.about:
Burning Sword tells the story of Zhang Yixiang (张逸羡) and his pursuit of power and vengeance for the death of his master. Hardcore action combat meets epic boss battles and careful customization, intermixed with subtle environmental storytelling and worldbuilding. Burning Sword emphasizes challenge, progression, and deep combat systems.

 The story is told subtly, but is full of character, political intrigue, and power dynamics. Starting in the year 1139 during the Southern Song Dynasty (南宋), you play as Zhang Yixiang just as he's cast down and nearly killed by the Elder of the Northern Mountain. The martial arts emerged during moments in history like this, when tyranny and brutality must be met with strength and passion.

 Enter the Burning Sword. Key combat features include:

 Yixiang's fury and anger give birth to a fiery Qi and the ability to wield a burning sword. Qi restores vitality, fuels techniques, and augments combat abilities. It is a scarce but critical resource.

 This martial art also emphasizes agility, speed, lightness and ease of traversal, letting Yixiang jump, wall-run, glide, and explore an expansive world.

 Wuxia-based swordplay and bodily attacks combine into a fierce and flexible combat style that leaves lots of room for experimentation.

 Players will dodge, parry, strike, combo, and acquire powerful techniques to carve a bloody path through mobs of enemies and make their way back to the Elder to finish the job. The combat rewards skill and timing, and punishes mistakes harshly.

 Finally, because the combat is this fun and rewarding, the game also...

store.name: Chained Together
store.short: Climb up from the depths of Hell. Scale various worlds solo or chained together with your friends in the 1-4 player platforming sensation.
store.about:
Climb or die! 
 Take on the challenge of the infamous hardcore platformer either alone or chained together with up to three friends.
 Climb as high as possible to escape Hell. Coordinate your clambering and perfect your jumps to scale punishing platforms and outrun the scorching heat. Every layer threatens your ascension with unique challenges, each tougher than the last.

 Will you make it to the summit or perish before glory? 
 Features 
 Choose your difficulty: Brave the punishing Normal Mode, play with checkpoints in Beginner Mode, or race against constantly rising flames in Lava Mode. It's masocore heaven!

 Local and online co-op:  Play together in person or online

 2v2 Race mode: Run for your life and climb higher than the other team in timed races 

 Realistic chain physics: The chain is fully simulated and wraps around platforms. Use this power to your advantage

 Leaderboards: Compare your climbs with the world

 Meaningful rewards: Leaderboards and Achievements are only valid in Normal and Lava Modes

copies.name: Carry the Glass Together! [2 Player Obby]

store.name: NAKWON: LAST PARADISE
store.short: NAKWON is a multiplayer zombie survival game set in urban South Korea. Venture into the city in the dead of night, and manage your shelter by day. Scavenge resources in a city crawling with the infected and hostile survivors. Survival is the only rule - trust no one, not even the living.
store.about:
Realistic Zombie Survival Where Every Day is a Fight to Stay Alive 
 NAKWON (or "Paradise") is an immersive zombie survival game where your only goal is to stay alive. Begin your life as a refuge in a safe haven built by survivors. Head out to scavenge for food and supplies in a city overrun by the infected to manage your shelter. Every little thing counts in your fight for survival. Kitchen tools become weapons, small wounds can be fatal, and stress will eventually break your mind if left unmanaged. All these elements come together to deliver an authentic and immersive zombie apocalypse experience.

 High-Risk Urban Expeditions Filled with Survivors and the Infected 
 Expedition areas are packed with the infected and other survivors who are desperate for resources. In this crumbling world, danger lurks around every corner and you'll never know what you're walking into. Survive the intense PvPvE expeditions in the ruins of a fallen city. Face the raw tension that grips your senses. Immerse yourself in the struggle to stay alive.

 Strategic Survival Action Through Any Means Necessary 
 Confrontation is not the only option—survival comes in many forms. Hide, run, betray, or cooperate. Do whatever it takes to make it out alive. Other survivors can't be trusted and the infected are deadly. In this world, your survival depends on the strategy you choose. 
To survive in the face of unpredictable threats, you must stay alert to everything around you.

 Bringing Together Extraction Looting and Survival Simulation 
 As a NAKWON citizen, you must maintain your shelter during the...

store.name: Mortal Shell II
store.short: Their Flesh Is Your Weapon. Mortal Shell II is a standalone sequel action-RPG with adrenaline-charged, high-stakes combat. Possess warrior Shells, dethrone false gods, redeem a ravaged world.
store.about:
Mortal Shell II is a standalone sequel to Mortal Shell that significantly expands on the original with unrestricted, adrenaline-charged combat, extensive weapon upgrades, and free exploration. 

The forgotten Shells of eight lost warriors are scattered throughout Mortal Shell II’s ravaged world. Seek and possess these Shells, unleash their innate abilities, and discover the story of each by unravelling their secrets.

 Mortal Shell II offers a clean, agile and grounded combat system, with options to think strategically about upgrading melee and ranged weapons.

Unrestricted by stamina, players exploit multiple tactics to shatter enemy posture and strike critically.

 Mortal Shell II’s open world is compact, tightly interconnected and immersive. It is designed with respect for the player's time. 

Those who wander from the golden path can discover new Shells, weaponry, upgrades, curiosities and more.

store.name: METRO 2039
store.short: METRO 2039 is the next landmark FPS from acclaimed storytellers, 4A Games. Journey into the dark heart of post-apocalyptic Moscow in a harrowing conflict for the very soul of the Metro.
store.about: Receive 10% off your Digital Deluxe Edition pre-order if you purchased any qualifying digital game from the METRO series.

store.name: Dispatch
store.short: Dispatch is a superhero workplace comedy where choices matter. Manage a dysfunctional team of misfit heroes and strategize who to send to emergencies around the city, all while balancing office politics, personal relationships, and your own quest to become a hero. All episodes out now!
store.about:
From the writers & directors of  Tales from the Borderlands and  The Wolf Among Us , 
 Dispatch is a superhero workplace comedy set in modern day Los Angeles. 

 You play as Robert Robertson, AKA Mecha Man, whose mech-suit is destroyed in a battle against his nemesis, forcing him to take a job at a superhero dispatch center: not as a hero, but a dispatcher. In charge of rehabilitating a group of ex-supervillains, you must manage your roster while navigating office relationships and rebuilding your suit for a shot at revenge. 

 In Dispatch , every decision you make influences the unfolding narrative. From banter in the breakroom to life-or-death situations in the field, your choices affect your relationships with the heroes, their allegiances, and the path your own story takes.

 Use the strategy map to review ongoing emergencies and deploy the right (or wrong) heroes to deal with them. Balance the risks and rewards as you make tactical decisions, knowing that each choice can have lasting consequences for your team and the city.

 Managing heroes sometimes goes beyond their powers. Each hero comes with quirks, flaws, and baggage you’ll need to navigate to keep the team together. Upgrade their skills and unlock abilities to boost their effectiveness in the field.
 Blending narrative, strategy, and humor, Dispatch  explores what it means to be a hero, whether you're wearing a cape or behind a desk.

 Featuring an all-star cast from every corner of entertainment
 Aaron Paul ( Breaking Bad, Westworld, Black Mirror )

 Laura Bailey ( The Legend of Vox Machina, The Last of Us...

store.name: RECUR
store.short: A time-bending journey to the end of the world and back. Run, jump, and manipulate time to solve puzzles as the apocalypse unfolds. Can you stop the clock on disaster?
store.about:
You’re just an average postman, but today is anything but average. It’s the end of the world and you suddenly have the power to control time itself. By moving forwards or backwards, you alone control the flow of time to solve problems, change outcomes, and discover secrets as you try to save the world.

 You need more than just reflexes to save the world: you’ll need to use your time-bending abilities to solve puzzles and traverse gargantuan obstacles. Explore a world falling apart in your quest to put things right. Or left.

 How did you get your powers? Why is the world ending? Unravel the secrets of RECUR as you discover a rich and engaging story, brought to you by the brilliant team behind A Juggler’s Tale.

store.name: Deep Rock Galactic: Rogue Core
store.short: DEEP ROCK GALACTIC: ROGUE CORE is a 1-4 player co-op shooter with sci-fi dwarves, procedurally-generated caves and random roguelike upgrades. Explore maze-like mines and blast through hordes of alien abominations — no two runs are the same. Move quickly, work together and shoot first to survive.
store.about:
Our deep-level mining operations have gone dark. Deep Rock Galactic needs them back online at any cost. We’re sending in a crack squad of Reclaimers to breach and secure the mines, and kill whatever’s down there.
 Your survival is not necessary for the success of this mission. 

 Step into the boots of the Reclaimers, Deep Rock Galactic’s elite corporate security force. In fast-paced 1-4 player co-op gameplay , you’ll fight through alien-infested mines as five playable classes:
 GUARDIAN: The walking shield. An expert in area denial and close protection. Damages enemies with concussive blasts, and restores the team’s armor.

 FALCONER: The aerial attacker. Deploys an airborne assault drone to electrify enemies. In an emergency, can even revive teammates from afar.

 RETCON: The hologram berserker. Can warp back to a previous point in spacetime, restoring health and ammo to recover from dangerous situations. Lethal in all time zones.

 SPOTTER: The marksman. Highlights and weakens targets with toxin darts, spots enemies through walls, and can deploy ammo crates for use in extended firefights.

 SLICER: The melee expert. Carries an energy blade capable of dismembering all but the toughest opponents. Mobile, agile, aggressive.

 No two runs are the same. The roguelike format means you’ll scavenge your weapons and equipment from within the mines, and collect resources to upgrade your gear and abilities. Choose from a deep pool of upgrades for your weapons and abilities, discovering lethal synergies and snowballing in power as you fight your way down to the Rift Gate.

 Linger...

store.name: Dust Front RTS
store.short: Dust Front is a classic RTS with grand strategy elements and a non-linear campaign. Lead strategic maneuvers, overwhelm your enemies with cannon fodder, or stomp them into the stone age with carpet bombing on the lifeless fields of Dust Front.
store.about:
Dust Front is a classic RTS with elements of grand strategy, procedural world and non-linear campaign. The action takes place on a planet devastated by many wars and upheavals, where under a thick layer of soot and concrete buried remnants of humanity's former might.

 Army creation. Arsenal of tanks, aviation, infantry and vehicles of various purposes.

 Base construction and resource gathering. Factories for the production of vehicles, refining minerals and barracks with storage facilities. All buildings are important on the global map as well.

 Procedural. Missions are combined with procedural map generation and external rules.

 Challenge. Asymmetrical gameplay. Battles with an enemy superior in number and strength. 

 GLOBAL MAP
 There will be no peace on Earth while the Empire's enemies roam it. Countless mutants, robots with far superior technology, rebels attacking us from the rear, and conspiracies we know nothing about. Do we have anyone more loyal than the army, or do we have no allies at all? 
 In the game, you will discover the value of your power on the global map .

 Global Economy. Mining and production within territories affects the economic situation in a strategic mode.

 Events. In the captured regions, news happens, in which you will participate through mini-dialogs. Merchants with resources and mercenaries with unique units can also appear.

 Technology branches. Unlock new units and buildings, improving and equipping them with more modern ways of destruction will lead to quick victories.

 Garrisons. Your troops gain ranks and can be moved from...

store.name: Terminator: Survivors
store.short: Judgment Day has come. As the rare survivor of this catastrophic event, fight and help the Resistance rise from the ashes of civilization. But beware, Skynet's machines patrol relentlessly the surface and the legendary T-800 is on your trail.
store.about:
Play as a survivor in this open world return to the iconic Terminator universe set in the aftermath of Judgment Day. 

Four years have passed since the day humanity almost disappeared. The truth behind this apocalyptic event has yet to be uncovered. You emerge from a shelter to try and re-establish a semblance of society, only to discover a world ravaged by Skynet, who seem hell-bent on eliminating you and the last remnants of humanity. 

Fight the first Skynet prototypes and help the Resistance rise from the ashes of civilization. But beware, the legendary T-800 is after you, and staying in one place for too long could prove fatal.
Investigate and discover the truth behind the nuclear apocalypse, Skynet and the Terminator threat.

 Meet iconic characters of the franchise as well as original ones and immerse yourself in a meticulously crafted world set in the post-apocalyptic future of James Cameron’s masterpiece.

 Fight formidable sophisticated machines and stop skynet from eradicating humanity again, but never forget: The fearsome and deadly Terminator is out there, hunting you, and a constant threat.

 Learn more about what happened on Judgment Day in an unexplored storyline and try to change humanity’s fate.

 Grow from the remnants of the old world at a home base you’ll use to establish a new foothold for humanity and stand tall against the machine threat.

 While you’ll be armed to attack up close and at range, stealth and caution may be more intelligent approaches with Skynet’s machines and scavengers lurking.

store.name: Astral Party
store.short: Astral Party is a multiplayer party game populated by cute anime girls! Choose your favorite character, strategize skills & cards, and roll the dice to destroy friendships in this unique board game.
store.about:
Astral Party is a board party game that supports online multiplayer with up to 4 players. This is a free to play game, with in-app purchases like skins, dress-ups that do not affect the gameplay balance.

 Board Party Game with Suspenses 
 A board game like no other! 15 different panel effects, random effects and events make every game full of suspense and unpredictability. With the roll of dice, you always have chances to turn the tables at the last minute.

 Over 10 Cute Anime Girls 
 This is an exciting dicing battle with vivid Characters, each with unique skills and beautiful illustration. 10 characters are available as the game launches, and will have more as updates add.

 4-Person Online Matches or Single Play with AI 
 Play how you want. Astral Party allows 1 to 4 players to compete online, or single-person play with AI. It's all the same friendship ruining fun.

 Dices & Cards & Battles & More 
 The crux of Astral Party lies in its one-on-one dice-based combat system, with a myriad of cards, effects, skill, events, and more. Card plays can augment your attack, and the dice decides if it is dodged. Every attack is like a small gamble, and nothing is more chilling than the moment you presume victory is within your grasp.

 Monsters Spice Up the Game More 
 As the game advances, monsters will surface on the board, some attacking players and others merely stealing coins. In the end, a formidable Boss will appear and relentlessly target the richest player. If it is you, be wary of other players’ "backstabs". (PS: Try beat the Boss to find out if there is reward...

store.name: ELDEN RING NIGHTREIGN
store.short: ELDEN RING NIGHTREIGN is a standalone adventure within the ELDEN RING universe, crafted to offer players a new gaming experience by reimagining the game’s core design.
store.about:
ELDEN RING NIGHTREIGN is a standalone adventure within the ELDEN RING universe, crafted to offer players a new gaming experience by reimagining the game’s core design.

 RISE TOGETHER.
Join forces with other players to take on the creeping night and the dangers within featuring 3-player co-op. Three Nightfarers will have two full days to explore the land of Limveld as they hunt one of the terrifying Nightlords. Find new companions or invite friends to join in an ever-changing 3-player co-op experience.

 BECOME A HERO.
Take command of eight uniquely skilled heroes, each possessing their own abilities and distinct flair. Each Nightfarer has three unique capacities: a passive ability, a character skill, and an ultimate art. These tools of survival and combat reflect each hero’s history and background. While individually formidable, their skills create powerful synergies when they unite as a team.

 TAKE ON THE NIGHT.
Your hunt takes place in Limveld, a transitory land, buffeted by the raging might of the Nightlords. These enormous beings lurk beyond the reach of most mortals and only reveal themselves when their commanders are defeated after two consecutive nights.Overcome a relentless environmental threat that sweeps through a land that changes between each game session and defeat the magnificent boss of that night.

Each Nightlord must be faced and defeated before the reign of night can be ended!

store.name: Annihilated
store.short: A story-driven roguelite RPG about a journey through the depths with a broken hero — and what they have to answer for. The hero's party has been annihilated: you carry one of them out of a cursed dungeon, learn what broke them, and settle it together. Four routes, four heroes, four reckonings.
store.about:
Annihilated is a story-driven roguelite RPG about a journey through the depths with a broken hero — and what they have to answer for. 

 You will play as the last survivor of the rescue party sent after the hero's party, who went missing deep in a cursed dungeon. When you finally reach the party members, you find:

 The Hero who lost the ability to speak.
 The Mage who lost the gift of magic.
 The Warrior who lost his mighty body.
 … and the Priest who lost ██.

 You can only carry one of them out. Choose your partner, and escape together.

 ■ Explore, fight, and lean on your partner 

 Choose your route, then fight in turn-based card battles. Every item you carry becomes a card with a limited number of uses, and enemies show you their next move before they act. Your partner fights beside you: the Hero shrugs off death, and the Priest heals like no one else.

 ■ Weapons hit hardest the moment they break 

 You get new gear by taking it from your enemies. Stagger a foe, then land a weapon's final use to trigger a Fatal Strike, which kills the enemy instantly and steals its equipment. Every weapon is at its strongest on its last use, so it often pays to shatter them on purpose, even when supplies run thin.

 ■ Bad roll? Spend a Curse and make it never have happened 

 Every shattered item leaves behind a Curse, and Curses let you Defy fate. Rolled the worst possible result? Spend a Curse, and it never happened. If you die, you retry from the floor where you fell. Stored Curses can be forged into the items you need, and the rest becomes experience. Every death makes the next...

store.name: Imperium  Eternal
store.short: Immerse yourself in the ultimate real-time strategy war game where all of human history is at your command. Create powerful empires across all eras on a scale never seen before.
store.about:
Immerse yourself in the ultimate real-time strategy war game where all of human history is at your command. Create powerful empires across all eras on a scale never seen before. Embracing unique RTS gameplay mechanics such as base building, resource management, and thrilling tactical combat, "Imperium Eternal" delivers thrilling tactical warfare spanning 20 eras of human civilization. 
 Your ultimate goal is to become the dominant empire on wolrd by commanding armies, building impenetrable cities, and engaging in thrilling tactical battles in the air, on land, and at sea.

More than just a strategy game, this is the ultimate saga where your empire not only endures, but must become truly eternal.

 LEAD YOUR CIVILIZATION THROUGH THE AGES 
 Witness the power of human evolution as you lead your civilization on an epic journey through history. Watch as stone tools evolve into devastating weapons made of bronze, steel, and futuristic technologies beyond your wildest imagination.

Each era of Imperium Eternal offers new challenges, achievements, and unique strategies. Dominate the battlefield with everything from simple equipment to the most advanced weaponry ever invented. In Imperium Eternal, you don’t just survive history, you define it forever.

 DOMINATE YOUR ENEMIES ON LAND, SEA, AND AIR 
 Take complete control of every battlefield. In Imperium Eternal, victory is not limited to a single dimension—you must dominate your enemies on land, sail the seas with mighty fleets, and conquer the skies. Command every combat environment by adapting your strategies.

 SINGLE PLAYER...

store.name: Onimusha: Way of the Sword
store.short: An Oni Gauntlet-wielding samurai makes a stand in Kyoto against the encroaching Genma menace. Through gritty, blood-soaked brawls, he searches for his reason to fight. What fate awaits at the end of his path?
store.about:
An all-new entry in the Onimusha series! 

Fight through bloodstained battlefields of intense swordplay action. Explore the historic Japanese capital of Edo-period Kyoto, twisted by malevolent clouds of Malice.
With every stage cloaked in mystery, danger and intrigue. Battle against monstrosities from the underworld known as Genma in a tale of dark fantasy.
Follow the tale of a samurai who wields the Oni Gauntlet, a mystical artifact that grants its bearer the power to slay Genma.
Through gritty, blood-soaked brawls, he searches for his reason to fight. What fate awaits at the end of his path? The Protagonist, Miyamoto Musashi 

An ardent samurai who arrives in Kyoto looking to prove that he is unmatched in the way of the sword. However, the path before him takes a strange and unexpected turn.

The protagonist of this game is a fierce young samurai, constantly moving from one bloody and gritty fight to the next. To cement this image of a striking samurai, Capcom has turned to none other than the late, iconic Japanese samurai movie legend Toshiro Mifune to star as the face model for this rendition of Miyamoto Musashi. Action 

Equipped with an Oni Gauntlet, Musashi is granted power beyond human limits. Besides giving him the strength needed to cut down the Genma, it also holds numerous other abilities, such as being able to absorb Genma souls and convert them into a power source to further enhance its wearer. But who is behind the voice that rings out from the gauntlet? Genma 

Usually found dwelling in the lowest depths of hell, the Malice enveloping Kyoto has brought...

store.name: Persona 6
store.short: The iconic RPG series returns! The highly anticipated next chapter delivers a bold, new standalone story blending heartfelt daily life and new characters with pulse-pounding, supernatural adventure. Whether it’s your first Persona game or you’ve been here since the beginning, this one’s for you.
store.about:
With over 30 million copies sold worldwide, the Persona series has defined a generation of RPG storytelling. Now, after years of anticipation, the next installment is finally revealed.
 Persona 6 brings everything beloved about the series into a bold new story. The signature blend of heartfelt daily life and pulse-pounding supernatural adventure returns, wrapped around a completely fresh, standalone story and new cast of characters. Whether you've been with the series since the beginning or this is your very first Persona experience, you belong here.
 Unleash Your Persona. Forge Unbreakable Bonds. 
 Awaken the power of Persona, a manifestation of your innermost self, and discover others who share this extraordinary ability. Every relationship you nurture makes you stronger. Every bond you forge becomes a weapon against the darkness lurking within.
 Live a Double Life in Modern-Day Japan.

You’ll discover why some bad memories don’t go away and encounter new challenges as Karin or Klaus deals with intense trauma responses brought on by the past.

Limited charges and different launch directions challenge you to connect each shot, jump, and landing into a route through the ruins.  Created by a team bringing together a level designer and veteran Celeste player, a former miHoYo worldbuilding designer, and a former Sunborn technical-audio creator.
 Why play Dashoot: ABYA’s Adventure? 
 • Control ABYA and the floating cannon independently, combining movement, aiming, and mechanisms.

 • Turn a first clear into a faster route, experimenting with shortcuts and ways to skip past obstacles.

 Read the landing. Make the jump.

store.about:
Decrepit is a first-person action game with souls-like combat about fighting your way out of a forsaken castle. Every death strips your gear and drags you back to the dungeons, restarting in a different cell each time.
 Your only advantages are the knowledge you gain from each attempt and whatever gear you can loot from the undead. Learn the castle and its inhabitants well enough, and what once felt impossible becomes manageable.
 Stamina-Based First-Person Combat 
 Combat is about positioning, timing, and reading enemy telegraphs. Each weapon has distinct attack patterns - light attacks, heavy strikes. Spells slot naturally into melee openings for strategic combinations. Manage your stamina, read patterns, and exploit openings. Mistakes are punished.
 Master the Castle 
 Each run begins in a different cell. Memorize winding corridors, unlock elevators that stay active, and discover passages that shorten your route. Learn which threats might appear where. Early runs feel endless. Later, you're heading straight for the boss that stopped you last time. The castle compresses as you learn it.
 Equipment Defines Your Build 
 You can carry one weapon, one staff, and one armor piece. These three slots define your playstyle. Find matching gear from the same archetype - Mage, Warrior, Rogue, or Shaman - and unlock set bonuses and unique abilities. Every slain enemy drops their gear. Adapt to what you find, or commit to hunting down a complete set.

 Twelve Character Classes

Each of the twelve character classes has its own three Ascendancy specialisations, resulting in a total of 36 Ascendancy Classes to pick between.

 New Skill Gem System 
Path of Exile 2 features 240 Skill Gems that grant devastating active skills and 200 Support Gems that modify their behaviour. Combine these together to create your perfect build.

 THE ORDER OF THE DOUBLE CROSS

 A world once full of water, life, and growing technology has fallen to the Awakened — the fusion of the living and the lifeless. No one knows where they came from, but their power keeps growing. From the ruins of the old world rose a new force: the Order of the Double Cross. Armed with unshakable faith and relics of the past, its Crusaders learned to seal Sacred Blood Pacts with powerful Awakened beings and wield their strange might. Now the fate of what remains depends on the warriors of the Order… and their allies.

Gather your comrades, load up your Crawler, and head out to conquer, rescue, build, or burn your way through these damned canyons. Will you risk everything for faith—or for glory and loot?
