 Dynamic World and Characters 

 Immerse yourself in a world where every choice ripples through the tapestry of the game. Inhabitants, driven by their unique character traits and familial ties, dynamically shape the cityscape based on players' interactions. They'll make their own decisions such as to stay at home, go to work, go out for fun, move to another city, build houses, run stores, avenge their family, run away from war etc.

 Agricultural and Livestock Farming 

 Cultivate a farm adorned with over 60 varieties of typical plants from ancient times. Tend to these plants' different needs for soil type, water and temperature to make sure their healthy growth. Form bonds with more than 30 creatures, transforming them into more powerful allies for riding or combat. Breed and train animals, with chances for mutations and discovering high-level species in the wild. 

 Enterprising Pursuits 

 Navigate a bustling cityscape, discovering a variety of vocations to amass wealth. Ascend the entrepreneurial ladder by establishing and managing vibrant businesses,...

store.name: Monster Train 2
store.short: Monster Train returns with all new clans, new enemy factions, new challenges, new modes and more! Defend your Pyre in the classic three-tiered, vertical gameplay that made the original roguelike deckbuilder a hit.
store.about:
Powerful beings known as Titans have seized control of Heaven. A makeshift alliance is formed between former angels and demons, who must learn to work together against their common foe. 

Now, you must command these clans aboard newly forged trains, and embark on your journey through Hell, Heaven, and the Abyss, to defeat the Titans before they destroy this world. 

Chaos awaits beyond the gates!

You’re in command! Choose from a selection of five brand new clans, each with its own unique strengths and gameplay to forge strategies fitting your personal playstyle. With three vertical levels to defend against dangerous new enemies, you’ll need to recruit powerful new units, upgrade cards, and experiment to survive. Can you defeat the all-new and ultra-challenging Titans?

Reach your deck’s full build potential with all new Room and Equipment Cards. Room Cards add impressive boosts to your train, allowing you new strategic advantages over your foes. Equipment Cards can be applied to units, giving them a variety of bonuses to aid you in battle! 

The Covenant Outpost is the bustling hub that you’ll visit after each run. From here, you’ll have access to Monster Train 2’s core features, as well as experience character interactions that move the story forward.

 Pyre Hearts : Each Pyre Heart brings unique functionality to gameplay. Unlocking them not only provides another way to customize your run before departing, but also plays a key role in advancing the story.
 Dimensional Challenges : Ready for a new twist on your adventure? This mode offers handcrafted challenges, new...

store.name: Climber Animals: Together
store.short: Climber Animals is a challenging and dynamic parkour game for 1-8 players. In this game,overcome obstacles and climb to the top with your friends. If you fall, your progress is lost and you start over. Keep your balance on this challenging climb and compete with your friends to reach the top.
store.about:
Climber Animals: Together is an exciting and challenging parkour experience for 1 to 8 players. In this game, players try to find their way through a world full of dynamic and challenging obstacles. Each obstacle tests players' strategy, speed and skill. On unique and vividly designed courses, you have the goal of reaching the top by racing shoulder to shoulder with or against your friends. 

 One of the most important features of the game is that with every fall, your progress is lost and players have to start all over again. While this creates an equal starting point for all players at the beginning of each level, it also increases the difficulty level of the game. This allows for different strategies and paths to be explored each time a level is retried.
 Players need to keep their balance and overcome obstacles to reach the top. In this process, it is important for players to use their reflexes, speed and strategic thinking skills. Players can cooperate with or challenge their friends to make their way through this challenging and fun course.

 Climber Animals: Together offers a fun and challenging course experience that appeals to all age groups, opening the door to enjoyable moments with your friends. 
 Every climb is a new adventure and every fall is another opportunity to try something new. Dodge spinning hammers, dodge boxing gloves and keep your balance on spinning poles on this exciting journey!

store.name: Vikings Dynasty
store.short: Embrace viking life and earn Valhalla’s blessing. Survive in the harsh norse environments and praise the Gods. Become a Jarl, control every aspect of your village and protect your community at all costs. Build and customize ships and explore the fjords in the unforgiving world of Vikings Dynasty.
store.about:
Narrowly escaping certain death after your ship is sunk in a thunderstorm, you find yourself in uninhabited territory. Survive against all odds in an ever-changing environment while you explore the wide open world and fight for your life , relying only on your abilities and natural resources. Build your first shelter and eventually expand your home into a thriving settlement . Experience real viking social life and structures , gain trust and ultimately, power. 

 With a variety of landscapes, dynamic weather, seasonal changes and the option to take your expeditions to the seas and explore even more areas, the open world of Vikings Dynasty is a dangerous beauty filled with secrets and sights to behold, offering an archipelago with multiple islands, fjords, underwater caves and other secrets.

 Collect natural resources, craft the tools you need, go out on a hunt and start building your home. Hone your skills and get access to dozens of items to craft and trade, while you grow your village and your following. Start a family and produce a worthy heir to continue your legacy adhering to all aspects of viking life.

 Master the art of shipbuilding and construct a variety of vessels from fishing or cargo boats up to longships and the legendary drakkar. Take to the seas and sail to other islands, where you might find not only rare resources that will give you and your people an edge, but also other villagers eager to join your cause.

 Establish a settlement and enhance it with a variety of buildings like workshops , smithy or carpenter , your fellow settlers follow your...

store.name: MARVEL Cosmic Invasion
store.short: A cosmic battle awaits! Choose between 15 Marvel Super Heroes in this frenetic action beat ‘em up to fight against the deadly Annihilation Wave threatening the galaxy. From New York City to the depths of the Negative Zone, the future of the Marvel Universe will be fought for across the stars!
store.about:
Tribute Games and Dotemu are teaming up again, in collaboration with Marvel Games, to craft an original, fresh beat 'em up. Featuring dynamic combat combos and dazzling pixel art, this planet-hopping adventure stands as a love letter to the Marvel Universe.

 So swears Annihilus, the living death that walks!
 After an unprecedented attack is launched across the galaxy, all life hangs in the balance.
 From New York City to the depths of the Negative Zone, the future of the Universe will be fought for across the stars in MARVEL Cosmic Invasion !

 Spider-Man, Wolverine, She-Hulk, Captain America, Phoenix, Black Panther, Storm and Iron Man, some of the most powerful earth-born Marvel Super Heroes, are ready to face the threat.
 But they won't be alone! Galactic Super Heroes Rocket Raccoon, Beta Ray Bill, Venom, Cosmic Ghost Rider, Nova, Phyla-Vell and the Silver Surfer enter the battle as well to complete the relentless line-up.
 All will join forces in a star-spanning brawling adventure against the deadly Annihilation Wave.

 Whether you’re an old-school expert or a first-time fan, you’ll find familiar faces and discover new favorites in a captivating roster of characters from across the Marvel Universe!

 With the Cosmic Swap tag-team system, choose two Super Heroes for each level and switch between them instantly. Create unique combos and powerful special attacks. Each character’s abilities encourage creative team-ups and a more tactical approach to the action.

 MARVEL Cosmic Invasion is a tribute to one of Marvel’s most iconic eras, with stunning full-color pixel art...

store.name: Marvel Rivals
store.short: Marvel Rivals is a Super Hero Team-Based PVP Shooter! Assemble an all-star Marvel squad, devise countless strategies by combining powers to form unique Team-Up skills and fight in destructible, ever-changing battlefields across the continually evolving Marvel universe!
store.about:
Marvel Rivals is a Super Hero Team-Based PVP Shooter! Assemble an all-star Marvel squad, devise countless strategies by combining powers to form unique Team-Up skills and fight in destructible, ever-changing battlefields across the continually evolving Marvel universe! 
 A Deep and Varied Marvel Roster
 Choose from a vast array of fan-favorite and cult-classic Marvel Super Heroes and Super Villains from across the Avengers, Guardians of the Galaxy, X-Men, and many more from across the Marvel Multiverse. 

 Fast and Fun 6v6 Action with Ever-Changing Game Dynamics
 With intricate environments, fast-paced gameplay, and ever-changing battlefields, there's never a dull moment in Marvel Rivals! Battle as Super Heroes and Super Villains with incredible abilities and combine your powers to bring unexpected fun to the battlefield in a matter of seconds.

 Dynamic Hero Synergy
 Coordinate unique combinations between characters to ignite surprising Team-Up Skills! Unleash the synergy of combined superpowers and invent new tactics that can turn the tide of combat. Ride on Groot's back as Rocket Raccoon to take on your enemies as a dangerous duo, unleash Gamma energy as Hulk to charge Iron Man's armor for massive damage, and so much more! 

 Creative Environment Destruction
 Tear your way through iconic Marvel worlds across destructible environments! From Asgard to the Tokyo of 2099, use superpowers to alter these environments, reshape the terrain, and craft a strategic advantage on the battlefield! Take cover to dodge attacks or use makeshift weapons to strike down enemies. Players...

store.name: SCP
store.short: Infiltrate breached SCP facilities in this tactical co-op horror extraction shooter. Survive surreal anomalies, recover forbidden intel, and escape.. or lose everything. The deeper you go, the stranger and deadlier it gets.
store.about:
An SCP containment facility has fallen. Anomalies roam free, reality fractures, and every second drags you deeper into the unknown. You and your team are the last barrier between the outbreak and the outside world.. if you make it out alive.

 Load your gear, steel your nerves, and descend into a nightmare that shifts every time you enter. The deeper you push, the richer the rewards… and the greater the risk. 

 Run solo for precision and stealth, or bring 2–3 teammates to watch your back. Every firefight is loud enough to wake things you’d rather not meet. Every decision, engage or evade could mean life or death.

 Powered by Unreal Engine 5, SCP: Outbreak blends surreal brutalist architecture with realistic bodycam-style gunplay. Every bullet has weight. Every wall can crumble. Every shadow could hide something watching. 

 Loot, extract, and expand your base to unlock new gear, research SCP artifacts, and prepare for even deadlier missions.

 From entities that stalk you in silence to phenomena that twist space itself, no encounter plays out the same way twice. Observe, adapt, or be consumed.
 Currently known SCPs:
 SCP-049

 SCP-087

 SCP-096

 SCP-106

 SCP-173

 SCP-294

 SCP-303

 SCP-427

 SCP-650

 SCP-682

 SCP-939

 SCP-3199

 You’re not just fighting to survive, you’re fighting to keep the outbreak from reaching the world outside. Every mission is a gamble. How deep will you go?

store.name: Fable
store.short: Become the Hero you want to be in an immersive open-world action-RPG where each choice shapes your journey, reputation is everything, and fairytale endings are never guaranteed.
store.about:
Pre-order Fable now to receive the Pre-Order Content Pack, featuring the questionably heroic Chicken Suit  and a collection of charming in-game Gifts: a Wild Flower Bouquet , a Toy Chicken , and a Scones & Jam Picnic Hamper . Use them to build your reputation and shape how Albion sees your Hero.*

 Become the Hero you want to be in an immersive open-world action-RPG where each choice shapes your journey, reputation is everything, and fairytale endings are never guaranteed.

 Fable returns in a stunning reboot of a beloved franchise. As the first Hero in a generation, explore a living Albion filled with peculiar characters, dark humour, and chickens... lots of chickens. This isn’t just nostalgia — it’s a new beginning set in a beautifully vibrant open world.

 Customize your Hero’s appearance and wield powerful weapons as you weave melee, ranged, and magical combat. Take on bandits, beasts, and creatures — including brand-new enemies and fan-favorites like Hobbes, Balverines, and Trolls. Your power grows right alongside your reputation.

 Beyond all the combat lies a living world where you can carve your own identity. Get filthy rich as a landlord or blacksmith, romance a villager (or three), have a bunch of kids, and watch as your reputation precedes you. Being a Hero is a bit like being a celebrity… if celebrities carried swords and occasionally battled giant fire-breathing chickens.

 In Albion, a Hero’s reputation is everything. Your noble deeds and questionable decisions affect your relationship with each villager and can even shape the world around you. Whose opinion...

store.name: ANEURISM IV
store.short: A dystopian simulator where your choices shape a decaying city. Join other players to protect the metropolis from ruin, hasten its downfall, or simply work in the factories. With no set goals or rules, every action has consequences in a world teetering on the brink.
store.about:
Enter ANEURISM IV , a sprawling metropolis where the proletariat works without question and the air is thick with decay. As a Spirit —a spectral entity on the verge of becoming flesh and bone—you stand at a crossroads. The city is yours to influence, disrupt, or simply observe. With no set goals or rules, how you engage with this world is entirely up to you.

 From the hardworking Prole to the affluent Banker , each fate offers unique abilities, challenges, and ways to interact with the city and its inhabitants. Your choice defines your journey:
 Align with the Cortex to stabilize and protect the city.

 Join the Scumbags or Zealots to spread the Rot and sow chaos.

 Remain Neutral and immerse yourself in daily life, working in factories or exploring the city.

 An ever-present threat, the Rot visibly alters the city as it spreads. Roles like Liquidators and Scumbags are pivotal in either containing or exploiting this menace. If left unchecked, the Rot will consume everything, leading to the city's demise.

 A Living, Breathing City
 ANEURISM IV is a sandbox simulator first and foremost. The city reacts dynamically to player actions:
 Take Down the City : Collaborate with others to bring about the city's downfall and witness its reset.

 Protect the City : Work to maintain order and keep the Rot at bay.

 Live Your Life : Engage in everyday activities or carve out a unique path—it's your choice.

 Survival depends on your willingness to work. Earn credits by taking on various jobs—labour in factories, manage resources as a Prole, or manipulate finances as a Banker. These...

store.name: Dawn of Defense
store.short: Dawn of Defense blends RTS, Tower Defense, and Roguelite progression. In a last defense, lead your tribe against the Empire: Command warriors in battle, fortify defenses, and build an economy as you fight to reclaim your ancestral homeland.
store.about:
In this mix of Tower Defense, RTS, and Roguelite progression, you fight for your tribe's survival. The Imperium Aeternum , a massive shadow empire, sends its legions to erase the North and silence its gods.
 From the Spiridun , the divine nexus of your forefathers, command your last defense: build towers and rally warriors . Hold the line against endless waves, then strike back to reclaim your lands.
 Each battle is a divine trial . As you fall and rise, ancient runestones awaken forgotten powers, reshaping your strategy with every run. Win the gods favor in the dawn of a new age: the Dawn of Defense .

 Your homeland withers under the Empire’s grip. Strike back against their strongholds, reclaim lost lands, and restore your tribe’s dominion.

 Battle enemies on two fronts: Defend yourself with towers and troops against enemy waves surging through the trenches, then command heroes and warriors in RTS sieges to capture new islands and enemy strongholds. 

 Every captured isle becomes a foothold for your people. Raise towers, rally warriors, claim strategy resources and build an economy to sustain your defenses against the Empire's forces.

 Face Empire warlords who challenge your defenses with unique tactics. With each run, uncover their identity, learn their patterns, and adapt your strategy to claim victory.

 Uncover the powers of ancient runestones and unlock upgrades for towers, warriors and economy, forging new strategies with every battle. 

 Each battle sharpens your tactics, unlocks new tools, and prepares you for greater challenges ahead. Rise stronger and stand...

store.name: 9 Kings
store.short: A fast-paced roguelike kingdom builder. Grow your empire and fight massive battles against powerful rival kings. Break the game with thousands of insane builds to become the King of Kings.
store.about:
Build your city into the most powerful of all kingdoms through endless combinations of buildings, units, spells, and positioning. Take advantage of chaotic combos and powerful perks to break the game and become overpowered. Grow your kingdom in strategic ways, prepare for dozens of unique events, and show the world your kingdom can outlast all others in both single and async multiplayer.

 From humble village to massive citadel, your capital recruits your units and grows their power. Expand your kingdom strategically over time and build it to survive decades of war and strife.

 From sturdy knights and warlocks, to glass cannon wizards and bombers, to hordes of fiendish imps and sentient mushrooms, there are dozens of units to lead and fight. Stockpile gold to hire thousands of mercenaries to your cause, use dark magic to raise the dead, and harness nature itself to bring down your enemies!

 Each of the kings has a different starting deck of buildings, troops, and spells, but you can loot the rival kings who attack your lands to access cards from their unique decks. Make peace with those whose units don’t fit your playstyle, and declare war against kings with the powers and units you covet, deploying the tools acquired from your enemy to unlock countless combinations of stacking buffs and modifiers to build an invincible army.

 Async multiplayer mode pits you against eight rival kings to see whose kingdom survives the longest. Climb the ranks and prove yourself to truly be the king of kings, complete with cosmetic customization using rewards you’ve unlocked through daily...

store.name: 30 Days on Ship
store.short: Take on the role of a castaway on a wrecked container ship. Survive for 30 days, battle storms, hunt animals, build shelter, and maintain your mental health, attempting to endure isolation and pirates in the middle of the Pacific. Can you stay alive?
store.about: Put yourself in the shoes of a castaway in a game after a maritime disaster. You find yourself on a massive container ship wrecked against a rocky shore. Survive for 30 days, using everything unconventionally that you find on board. Battle unpredictable storms, hunt wild animals, construct shelter from the remnants of the ship. Take care of your mental health and creatively utilize resources found in containers to survive in complete isolation from civilization. Can you stay alive in this extreme isolation in the middle of the Pacific?

store.name: Battlefield™ 6
store.short: The ultimate all-out warfare experience. In a war of tanks, fighter jets, and massive combat arsenals, your squad is the deadliest weapon.
store.about:
The ultimate all-out warfare experience. Fight in high-intensity infantry combat. Rip through the skies in aerial dogfights. Demolish your environment for a strategic advantage. Harness complete control over every action and movement using the Kinesthetic Combat System. In a war of tanks, fighter jets, and massive combat arsenals, the deadliest weapon is your squad. This is Battlefield 6. 

 Victory, however you envision it. Battlefield 6 has more ways to win than ever before. Seize glory in iconic massive maps, or jump into fast-paced close quarters combat. Change the rules of war with the revamped and refined Battlefield Portal. Fight in iconic locations all over the world including Cairo, Brooklyn, Gibraltar, Japan, and more. More ways to play. More paths to victory. 

 Drive tanks across the Sahara. Storm the beaches of Gibraltar. Defend New York from invasion. Join an elite squad of Marine Raiders fighting relentlessly to save a world on the edge of collapse. 

 Redraw the lines of battle. Battlefield Portal is a massive sandbox where creators and players can push Battlefield to the limit. Take unprecedented control of your environment by moving, scaling, and duplicating objects. Create a completely unique game mode using NPC scripting and a customizable UI. Legendary Battlefield experiences are waiting to be created — show ‘em what you’re made of. 

 Battlefield’s new Kinesthetic Combat System makes you more connected to your soldier and environment than ever before. With overhauled gunplay and tactical movement, from crouch sprint to drag and revive, every shot and...

store.name: Vindictus: Defying Fate
store.short: Vindictus: Defying Fate is a dark medieval fantasy action RPG inspired by Celtic mythology. Choose a hero with a unique combat style and face colossal bosses alone or alongside other players. In a world where everyone accepts their fate, the power to change the ending is in your hands.
store.about:
Vindictus: Defying Fate is an action-packed RPG featuring intense combat and thrilling battles. 

 Every Hit Counts, Every Action Matters. 
 One moment can change your destiny.
Master perfect dodge, powerful counters, and heavy-hitting strikes to experience unparalleled combat.
Explore unique skills and diverse command inputs exclusive to each character, delivering a stylish and fascinating action style.

 Immersive Worlds, Memorable Characters. 
 Dive into meticulously designed 3D dungeons and beautifully varied landscapes.
Showcase your personality with stunning character costumes and expressive gestures that elevate your gaming experience.
Fight fiercely, customize freely, and express yourself vividly.
 Ready to Conquer? 
 Only those bold enough to challenge fate will emerge victorious.
In this crucial moment, survival is everything.
The battlefield calls. Are you ready?
 Wishlist now and prepare for battle.

store.name: Stormforge
store.short: Brave magical storms where tornadoes hunt you in this open-world survival crafting game for 1 to 8 players. Outrun the tornadoes or ride their winds, sail to new islands, defeat bosses to unlock classes, and build a home that can weather the next chaos storm.
store.about:
Storms in the land of Sorana work like dungeons out in the open world. Each one is guarded by tornadoes that hunt you and hazards that keep you on your toes, from lightning strikes to toxic clouds and fire spurts. Break the crystal to clear the storm for good, then set out to find the next one.  
 Hunting Tornadoes - Outrun or glide around tornadoes that hunt you down, hurling trees, boulders and even enemies at you

 Storm Guardians - Destroy the generators or find other ways to bring down the shield and fight storm-powered enemies protecting the storm's crystal

 Storm Rewards - Gather resources infused with storm magic, and earn skill points from the storms you clear

 Roaming Chaos Storms - Seek shelter and protect your base with a magic shield while large chaos storms sweep across the entire map

 Build your base piece by piece, or move into an abandoned village house and make it your own. Place a crystal pillar at its heart to shield it from the chaos storms.  
 Round Building Pieces - Build round walls and floors from your very first camp

 Craft From Storage - Craft straight from any chest within your crystal pillar's radius

 Quick-Stack & Free Repairs - Sort your whole inventory into matching chests with one button, and repair your gear for free

 Free Placement - Switch between basic snapping, advanced snapping and free placement, and overlap pieces however you like

 Set out across a procedurally generated world the storms have reshaped, with a new map for every world you create.  
 3 Biomes - Travel from the Whispering Vale and the Howling Woods to the Ember...

store.name: Citystate Metropolis
store.short: The creative, pragmatic, limitless city builder. Engineer a masterpiece of urban design, a small sustainable town or a futuristic metropolis. With procedurally generated buildings, grid-less zoning and powerful editor tools, everything is customizable: the city is yours.
store.about:
Citystate Metropolis is a city-builder with grid-less zoning tools and procedurally generated buildings. The simulation is powered by a crowd-based model that can handle populations exceeding one million. 
 The city planning tools can create neighborhoods of all types and shapes by allowing total control over building footprints, setbacks, floor counts and parking spaces. Beyond creativity and aesthetics, plans and regulations are also the very drivers of the city’s growth, its socioeconomic profile; and thus, how the city looks and feels. Build simple and cheap to decrease housing costs and foster social mobility. Build fancy and eco-friendly to increase land value and attract foreign investors. 
 Experiment to find the perfect balance between form and function. Expand the city at your own pace and set your own goals. There are countless ways to manage a city-state, countless ways to grow a small town into a true Metropolis.

 Creative: The Architect
 Height, width, colors, and shapes of all residential, commercial, industrial, and service buildings can be designed  from the ground up. Along with a choice of 40 road types and a park editor, Citystate Metropolis grants total creative freedom.

 Pragmatic: The Governor
 Cheap and unregulated to quicken growth or restricted and gentrified to boost tax revenue? Whether the governor’s end goal is to build an eco-friendly haven, a capitalist powerhouse, or a work of art, the budget needs to be balanced, taxes have to be collected and hard decisions will have to be made.

 Limitless: The World Builder
 The map editor can create...

store.name: The Jackbox Megapicker
store.short: The Jackbox Megapicker is a game launcher for all of your Jackbox games. This free bit of software will allow you to launch all owned games from one convenient location. This means that you will no longer need to switch between Party Packs to start playing the games you love most.
store.about: The Jackbox Megapicker is your all-in-one solution for organizing, buying, and launching all of your Jackbox games. You no longer have to switch between Party Packs to start playing your favorite games. The Megapicker will give you an overview of the games that you own so you can launch them directly. View games you might be missing, and see news updates and ongoing sales all in one place. Filter your games by genre and create an account to store your preferences and see your game history.

store.name: Valor Mortis
store.short: Valor Mortis is a first-person action soulslike from the creators of Ghostrunner. Rise from death as a former soldier of Napoleon’s army. Wield supernatural powers, battle horrifying monsters, and unravel a conspiracy that threatens all of humanity.
store.about:
You are William, a soldier of the Grande Armée brought back from a battlefield grave. But the Europe you awaken to is not the one you sacrificed for. A mysterious plague now sweeps the continent, and you have been reborn with its corrupting power pulsing through your veins.

 Each death is a chance to grow stronger. Master a combat system of parries, dashes, and visceral finishers across a variety of weapons. Channel your power to enhance attacks and unlock new supernatural abilities to inflict upon your enemies. 

 Navigate a 19th-century alternate history where the costs of endless war have corrupted the landscape. Use your newfound mobility to outmaneuver the plague-ridden abominations of Napoleon’s Eternal Guard and uncover environmental secrets that may increase your chances of survival.

 Witness a compelling story where historical figures and realities intertwine with elements of horror and the supernatural. Explore beyond the dark corners of the world to discover the truth behind the plague and your unholy resurrection.

store.name: Game of Thrones: War for Westeros
store.short: Classic real-time strategy in the world of Westeros. Conquer the Seven Kingdoms solo, or dominate your enemies to claim the Iron Throne in multiplayer skirmish. Command the Great Houses, rally iconic heroes, and rewrite the fate of the realm.
store.about: In War for Westeros, chaos reigns in ruthless battles across the Seven Kingdoms. Command the Great Houses in epic real-time strategy battles, and stake your claim to the Iron Throne.

store.name: Into the Wind
store.short: Drive, fly, and run deliveries together with your sentient motorcycle-plane, Ermes. Make friends, battle rowdy air pirates, upgrade your bike, decorate your home, explore the islands of Santa Rosa, and solve the mystery of your uncle's disappearance.
store.about:
Drive, fly, and run deliveries together with your sentient motorcycle-plane, Ermes. Make friends, battle rowdy air pirates, upgrade your bike, decorate your home, explore the islands of Santa Rosa, and solve the mystery of your uncle's disappearance.
 It's time to build a new life, far away from the mainland, out here among the aviation crazy, freedom loving islanders and sky pirates!
 Drive, fly, deliver 

 Easy to pick up and deep in skill expression, we've spent a lot of time tuning Ermes to feel both physical and arcadey. Cargo has weight, and fuel matters. Roads, shortcuts, weather, wind, and bad landings are all part of the journey.
 Earn money, upgrade your bike, expand your business 

 Carry out deliveries all over the islands: some delicate that have to be handled with care, others heavy that make going up (or down) hill more difficult. Doing jobs earns you resources you use to upgrade Ermes, allowing you to take on more challenging deliveries and adventures.
 Make the world your own 

 Between deliveries, you can customize both yourself and Ermes, and decorate and furnish your home and the base of your crew. Decorations need to be delivered back to base: each little thing has to be earned. Depending on what you bring back, and where you place it, you and your crew will get bonuses that help you progress further in the game.
 Friendships and a mystery to solve 

 Your uncle Umberto went missing while investigating a mysterious cloud in the skies above Santa Rosa. By making deliveries, getting to know your crew, and learning more about Santa Rosa and its...

store.name: Nocturnal 2
store.short: Ignite your sword and explore the dark depths and towering heights of a forgotten island that consumed itself long ago.
store.about:
Nocturnal 2 is an atmospheric action adventure game that invites you to explore the dark depths and towering heights of the city of Ytash.
 Features
 Explore an interconnected city, discover hidden passages, and unlock new paths with new abilities.

 Use your flaming sword to fight enemies and bring fire back to the city.

 Enjoy fast, fluid movement and responsive combat.

 Discover a hand-drawn world inspired by Persian architecture.

 Gather strange arcana and poems that may lead you down unexpected paths.

store.name: Outward 2
store.short: Outward 2 is a challenging action RPG with survival elements, focusing around a grounded experience. There’s no hand-holding, no scaled encounters, no divine blessings to make you tower over your enemies. Eat your meal, check your map, grab your backpack: an unforgiving, rewarding adventure awaits.
store.about:
We designed Outward 2 to be the ultimate simulation of an adventurer’s life. It offers a believable, relatable, and deeply human journey complete with all the hardships that come with it. 
 But worry not: you’ll have all the tools you need to overcome the challenge.

 Aurai is more than just breathtaking landscapes. It is a perilous world where most people never dare to leave the safety of their hometown walls. When you choose to go out there, come prepared: hunger, thirst, exhaustion, and harsh weather can be just as deadly as the creatures that roam the wilds. You're only human, struggling to survive against the odds. Don't count on mounts or fast travel to make things easier for you.

 In Outward, every factor matters, and each one influences your playstyle. Every weapon type has its own unique moveset. The weight of your armor affects your movement speed, and its materials determine how well it protects against different weather hazards. Beyond weapons and armor, you also need to consider what you eat and drink, what kind of tent you sleep in, and which backpack suits you bests.

 Beyond your equipment, you also need to master the right skills. In Outward 2, you are not innately powerful. As a commoner, you don't even start with any magical affinity. You must earn your growth and use the tools at your disposal to gain the upper hand. Fortunately, trainers scattered throughout Aurai will teach you the skills needed to survive even the most brutal encounters...for a price. By studying under them, you can specialize in up to three classes at once, allowing you to shape...

store.name: Knight's Path
store.short: Step into a story-driven action RPG set in a grounded low-fantasy world inspired by the Holy Roman Empire. Rise from a nobody to a respected knight through hard-earned, immersive progression. Master HEMA-inspired combat and explore forests, villages, castles, and the living town of Eranthold!
store.about:
Knight’s Path is a story driven action RPG set in a grounded low fantasy world inspired by the Holy Roman Empire. You play as Alryk, a young disgraced noble who has lost everything and is forced to rebuild his life from nothing. What begins as a struggle to reclaim his lost status soon grows into a deeper calling. You come to realize that the people of Eranthold need you, and how you respond is your choice. You may walk the knightly path, embracing duty, sacrifice, and service to others, or you may act out of self interest, seeking personal gain and comfort. Through discipline and hardship, your decisions shape what kind of knight Alryk becomes, and what his name will come to represent.
 Combat is inspired by Historical European Martial Arts and built around authentic stances and techniques.  You’d leave… if your car hadn’t died miles from anywhere. It’s 1992. No cell phones. No rideshares. No help coming, and you’ll soon find that you are not alone inside the attraction. 
 You’ll encounter monstrous creatures that will hunt, chase, and torment you. Take a moment to catch your breath, it may be your last.

 RUN. CLIMB. SURVIVE. 
 Terrible Lizards blends horror with first‑person parkour, creating a relentless chase experience that feels intuitive to learn and has a lot to master. 
 You’ll be hunted by creatures that stalk the abandoned dino depot. They shamble and charge toward you, forcing you to run, jump, climb, wall run, bounce, and slide to survive. There are no weapons except your wits.

From the creators of SOMA comes ONTOS, a sci-fi adventure that takes you to the edge of reality. You are Aditi Amani, invited to the repurposed moon hotel Samsara by the cryptic legacy of your estranged father, a brilliant mind-turned-prophet. What begins as a search for answers quickly spirals into something far stranger. Samsara is no ordinary outpost, but a place where reality fractures, where truths are buried beneath layers of deception and obscurity. As you delve deeper, guided by fragments of your father’s past, you must confront disturbing revelations about the nature of existence - and your place in it.

ONTOS presents a gauntlet of chilling experiments and disturbing encounters that push the boundaries of both science and morality. Each test invites you to peel back another layer of a world that takes you one step closer to the ultimate truth. Confront existential questions that will make you question the nature of the soul, suffering, and the very fabric of reality itself. These trials are not just puzzles—they are provocations. Your choices echo forward, and you must be prepared to face the consequences. Foresight is paramount, but even what you judge to be the best moral actions can lead to devastating outcomes.

 FIGHT WITH ANYTHING YOU CAN FIND

 TURN THE WORLD INTO A WEAPON

store.short: After the dungeons have been plundered and the monsters all killed, an elderly witch quietly gets to work. In this emotionally-rich, stylized, single-player adventure - Gert will need to build a bond with a peculiar creature if she’s to fulfill a coven’s oath.
store.about:
The World of the Coven 
 The dungeons are plundered and the monsters are killed. As heroes move on, an elderly witch quietly gets to work. Gertie has long awaited her moment to prove herself to the coven. Having pledged to counter the so-called “heroes” and their unbridled pride, she’ll require the assistance of an odd creature.
 Coven of the Chicken Foot is a charming yet dark, character puzzle-platformer set in a stylized world that ‘winks’ at the tropes of a traditional fantasy-adventure game. As Gertie, you will venture into dark dungeons, lush forests, catacombs of fallen heroes, and mucky bogs that kill all those that dare enter. Gertie is not your typical hero: She won’t be swinging swords or double-jumping her way past dangers. Instead, she must learn to work with and adapt to her peculiar companion to survive.

 The Playable Relationship 
 Gert’s new companion is a curious concoction that learns and adapts from its witchy partner. As they journey together, the creature slowly reveals an independent streak and motivations of its own. Built on pioneering tech, Wildflower Interactive has crafted a non-playable ally companion unlike any other; a dynamic, responsive creature that reacts and evolves its abilities and motivations throughout the player’s experience.
 With a semi-open world, systems-rich design, and thoughtful environmental storytelling, Coven of the Chicken Foot rewards curiosity, letting you uncover mysteries on your own. store.name: The Enigma Cases
store.short: Uncover the truth behind America’s most mysterious murders of the 2000s in a 1–4 player co-op detective experience. Use special equipment to find hidden clues, track suspects in an open world, and interrogate them at the police station.
store.about:
What is The Enigma Case? 🕵️‍♂️ 
 The Enigma Cases is a co-op detective game set in Sunderwood, an alternative town in 2000s America. Play solo or with up to 4 players and step into the role of a real detective.
 Examine crime scenes, gather and analyze physical and digital evidence, follow suspects’ trails, and interrogate them at the police station. Every decision you make brings you closer to uncovering the truth behind each case. 

 Varied Cases 
 Each case tells a unique story, ranging from murders and accidents to suspicious deaths. No two investigations are the same.
 Explore realistic locations, from cafés and apartments to highways and restricted areas. Every crime scene is carefully designed and filled with clues waiting to be discovered, analyzed, and connected.

 Detective Roles 
 Investigations are shaped by different detective approaches.
 As a Field Detective , you collect physical evidence, examine crime scenes in detail, and interrogate suspects face to face.
 As a Cyber Detective , you focus on digital trails. Analyze emails, GPS records, social media accounts, databases, and security systems to uncover hidden connections.

 Multiplayer Cooperation 
 Solve cases together with your friends in co-op play for 1–4 players.
 Each player can take on a different role, share findings, and combine evidence to move the investigation forward. Cooperation and communication are essential to uncovering complex truths. 

 In-Depth Investigations 
 Use professional tools at the police station to advance your case.
 Analyze CCTV footage, scan DNA traces, access restricted...

store.name: TCG Card Shop Simulator
store.short: Open your own local game store. Stock shelves with the latest booster packs, or crack them and collect the cards for yourself. Set your own prices, hire staff, host events, and expand your card shop.
store.about:
TCG Card Shop Simulator is a trading card shop simulation where you sell card booster packs to earn money and build your card shop business.

 Manage Your Shop:
 Design your own TCG shop. Organize shelves and card packs to make the customer shopping experience smooth and easy. 

 Card Collection:
 Open the booster packs yourself and collect the cards. Find rare cards and sell them to make a fortune, or keep them to complete your card collection.

 Host Game:
 Set your card game format and fee, invite players to play card games in your shop. Be sure to keep your store clean and hygienic for the players or they might leave!

 Order Products:
 Stock up on different booster card packs and card game products. Keep track of popular trends and adjust your inventory to cater to the ever-changing demands of your customers.

 Expand Your Business:
 Earn profits to reinvest in your shop. Expand your space, unlock new card sets, and upgrade your facilities to attract even more customers and increase revenue.

store.name: God Save Birmingham
store.short: Judgment Day has come to medieval Birmingham, and a plague of flesh-hungry ghouls has claimed every living soul… except one. Fight to survive in a highly tactile, physics-based survival sim where every object can be manipulated. Make ends meet, or meet your end.
store.about:
God Save Birmingham is a physics-driven zombie survival simulator set in medieval Birmingham, England. As the town’s only survivor, you must scramble to fulfill your everyday needs, while avoiding the grasping hands and rotten teeth of your former friends and neighbors. 
 A HISTORICAL TOWN WITH A HELLISH TWIST  

 Explore a painstakingly rendered and reimagined medieval market town, now teeming with undead. But don’t let that stop you from seeing the sights! Drop by the historic Bull Ring, grab a bite to eat at the markets, or take a moment to rest at Saint Martin’s Church. Just remember to bar the doors first. 
 PHYSICS THAT MATTER  

 Almost every object in the game can be moved or manipulated to aid your chances of survival. Barricade a door with a dining table, grab a barrel and go bowling for zombies, or set a rushlight on the ground to light the room while you sleep. 

 But the laws of nature also apply to you. Trip over a ledge, and you may lose your weapon. Fall from too high, and you might break your leg. 
 HARDCORE SURVIVAL GAMEPLAY  

 With the town in chaos, simply staying alive is a struggle. You’ll have to scavenge food, secure clean drinking water, keep warm, seek shelter at night, and try not to fall ill, all while dealing with a constant undead siege. 

 But man does not live by bread alone. You’ll also have to manage your mental state to avoid lapsing into despair or madness. You can also level up various survival-related skills by continuously practicing them, including mastery over certain weapon types. 
 HOME IS WHERE THE HEART IS  

 With no one left...

 To you, however, this is a hope for a new life. Recruit villagers and grow a community. Defend against the elements and forest tricksters. Thrive and celebrate the seasons’ traditions. Rebuilding won’t be easy, but you and your newfound friends are up to the challenge.
 Former developers from Bethesda, BioWare, and Naughty Dog bring you a sandbox RPG realm of anthropomorphic animals and fairy creatures. Play this Play co-op or solo as you build a village of memorable NPCs, farm, craft, explore, and celebrate the seasons in an ever-changing world bigger than you.

 Recruited by Death, you’ll enter dangerous maps, complete objectives, fight enemies or other players, and secure your loot.

 Alongside the high-stakes Reaper-vs-Reaper-vs-Environment extraction, you’ll get more ways to match your playstyle. PvE maps let you uncover the mystery of the dead gods at your own pace, without risking your gear. Or choose to play in a party, which will allow you to team up to fight factions and uncover more of the story after taking the first steps into the afterlife.  With the Respawn mechanic, Death grants you a second chance. After dying for the first time, you can reclaim your own corpse or possess another fallen Reaper’s body to attend to your unfinished business in the afterlife.

store.name: C-Beams

C-Beams is a top-down space action RPG where you pilot your ship through a perilous black hole system. Navigate treacherous anomalies, engage in intense ship-to-ship combat, and upgrade your vessel to face ever-greater challenges.
 In the future, humanity has begun reaching out into the stars. The discovery of a new black hole system has sparked a gold rush, drawing corporations and daring pilots eager to claim its riches. Those brave enough to face hazardous anomalies and hostile competitors can amass great fortunes by extracting rare, never-before-seen elements.
 As a new pilot with nothing to lose, you'll decide how to carve your legacy in this unforgiving frontier.

 Pilot a variety of ships, each featuring highly realistic handling characteristics. Engage retro burns to decelerate rapidly, cut your engines to drift silently through space, and master maneuvering thrusters to evade enemy fire.
 Docking at space stations or derelict ships is a skillful art. The better you become at piloting, the faster you'll complete missions and earn rewards.
 However, overloading your cargo hold will increase your ship's mass, making it sluggish and harder to maneuver. Keep an eye on your fuel reserves—running out of boost fuel at the wrong moment could be the difference between victory and defeat.

 Tear enemy ships apart in chaotic close-range firefights using rapid-fire gatling turrets and recoilless cannons, or pick them off from a distance with guided missiles, railguns, and powerful C-Beams. Sub-system targeting allows you to disable engines, weapons, or radar for a tactical...

store.name: Witch the Showdown
store.short: Witch the Showdown is a high-difficulty parry-action game where every battle is a boss fight. Build mana through precise parries, then unleash attacks in real time using your cards—this unique combat system defines the experience.
store.about:
A fast-paced, addictive parry-action combat system fused with strategic deckbuilding. 
This single-player real-time action game is designed for fans of intense action and competitive play. Every opponent you face is a boss-level threat. 
Build mana through well-timed parries, then unleash powerful attacks using your cards.

 The game features five difficulty settings, ranging from Rookie to Master.
The highest level, Master, is designed to challenge even the most dedicated action and competitive players—clearing it is a true achievement.
 At the same time, players who want to enjoy the unique systems and story at their own pace can choose from a variety of difficulty options.
Each level is carefully balanced, and your results are saved separately, allowing you to clearly track your growth and improvement as you play.

 Duel Mode comes with pre-built decks, allowing you to jump straight into the action.
It’s perfect for players who want quick sessions or those aiming to master every enemy attack with flawless parries.
 Tournament Mode lets you build your strategy from the cards and accessories you’re dealt, taking on consecutive battles as you fight your way toward the championship.
This mode offers a rogue-like experience with a fresh challenge every run.

 Set in a near-future fantasy world where magic, swords, guns, and machines coexist, the story explores each witch’s reasons for entering the tournament and the relationships they forge with their rivals along the way.

store.name: Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2

Built on the explosive combat of Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun, charge headfirst into glorious battle armed with an arsenal of deadly weapons. Shred enemies with your lethal chainsword, blast them into an explosion of pixels and blood with your Shotgun or set them aflame with a torrent of liquid fire from your Flamer!

As your arsenal improves, so do the enemies! Eviscerate enemies from the four Chaos god factions (Nurgle, Tzeentch, Khorne, and Slaanesh) in glorious, visceral fashion. The ferocious Bloodletters and their...

Guns, Gears & Giddy-up!

 The Wild West, But Weirder  
 This is the Wild West, but not as you know it. Alongside dusty saloons and endless deserts, you’ll encounter haunted mines, reanimated skeletons, and deadly storms at every turn. Complete daring contracts, explore cursed lands, and watch out for the giant ghost train.

 Shoot Fast, Spell Faster & Survive Together.  
 Switch seamlessly between six-shooters and fireballs, customize your gear, and combine your spells as you face waves of enemies and powerful bosses. Work as a team, adapt on the fly, and push deeper into the unknown to unlock bigger challenges and better rewards.

 Customise, upgrade and gear up  
 Trade at town to upgrade your guns, spells and abilities. Pick your perks to build the ultimate bounty hunter. Specialise in spell damage, healing or headshots. Customise your robot cowboy and beloved steed with unlockable skins to traverse the Far Far West in style.

store.name: Expedition: Into Darkness

Driven by an insatiable thirst for glory, power, and untold riches, you will battle innumerable deadly creatures and uncover dark secrets as you pursue your damned ambitions.Stand against the horrifying enemies in this PvE extraction game.

 Death means losing your character and everything they carry, permanently. If you want to return out alive with your hard-earned loot—be careful and deliberate. Anything stored in your base camp is safe.

 Return with resources from the depths to repair and upgrade your base of operations—exploit upgrades to assist with your next venture for more riches and antediluvian knowledge.

 Nightmarish creatures, deadly traps, unstable structures, hidden drops, and toxic gasses—you have been warned.

 Unleash your creativity by designing custom shirts for unique customers! Draw anything, print it, and watch them proudly wear your creations in style!

store.name: Assassin’s Creed Shadows
store.short: Experience an epic action-adventure story set in feudal Japan! Become a lethal shinobi assassin and powerful legendary samurai as you explore a beautiful open world in a time of chaos.
store.about:
MASTER THE DEEPEST STEALTH MECHANISMS OF THE SERIES & FIGHT IN VISCERAL COMBAT
 “Shadows is some of the most fun I’ve had with a stealth game in a decade” —PC Gamer
 Play as Naoe, a quick-witted shinobi, and use light, sound, and shadows to evade detection. Infiltrate enemy strongholds with many parkour options including the new grappling hook, distract guards with shuriken or smoke bombs, and assassinate your targets with your Hidden Blade. As the samurai Yasuke, use silent bow takedowns or unleash devastating melee combos with your katana or naginata.
 Switch between these two heroes to adapt your strategy and experience feudal Japan through two radically different approaches – stealth and strength, shadows and steel.

 DEEP-DIVE INTO THE CAPTIVATING WORLD OF ASSASSIN'S CREED SHADOWS
 “Assassin’s Creed Shadows creates one of the best versions of the open-world style.” —IGN
 Step into feudal Japan like never before! From majestic castle towns to serene shrines and sweeping countryside, Assassin’s Creed Shadows offers a breathtaking open world where dynamic seasons, shifting weather, and environmental destruction affect your tactical approach.
 And, to get full immersion, experience the game through Japanese voiceover.

 DISCOVER THE MOST TECHNICALLY ADVANCED ASSASSIN’S CREED GAME YET
 “It leads to one of the most dynamic, fun, and best-looking open-world games I’ve played this generation.” —Kotaku
 Experience a true next-gen leap with Assassin’s Creed Shadows, powered by the updated Anvil engine. Explore a world brought to life with ray-traced Global Illumination,...

store.name: Hela: of Mice & Magic
store.short: See the world through the eyes of a brave little mouse in this enchanting 3D co-op adventure. Explore breathtaking landscapes inspired by Northern Sweden, solve puzzles, and be a force for good in a land where heartwarming storytelling and the beauty of nature intertwine.
store.about:
When the old can no longer protect the land, the small must learn to carry the tune.  
 For as long as anyone can remember, a kind witch has cared for the forest and the creatures who call it home. But now, the world is beginning to fall out of harmony—and the witch who has always protected it is growing ill.
 Her smallest familiars must venture beyond the shelter of home and learn to carry the responsibility that once belonged to her. Though she cannot join them, her magic is never far away—a gentle hand, ready to lift them back to safety.
 Playing as a brave little mouse, you’ll journey through a vast world shaped by the beauty and wonder of Swedish nature, helping those you meet and restoring harmony one act of kindness at a time.
 Hela: of Mice & Magic is a heartfelt 3D open-world adventure about care, courage, and discovering how much even the smallest among us can do. Explore alone or share the journey with friends in local split-screen and online co-op.

 Carry Her Kindness Into the Wild 
 The witch has spent her life caring for the world around her. Now, it is your turn to care for her and to continue the work she can no longer carry alone.
 Gather ingredients, brew magical potions, solve environmental puzzles, and lend a helping paw to animals and communities throughout the land. Each small act brings you closer to restoring its harmony and helping the witch who has long cared for you and all the forest’s inhabitants.

 See the World Through Tiny Eyes 
 Travel through a lovingly crafted playground inspired by the landscapes of Northern Sweden, from rugged mountain...

store.name: Infinity Nikki
store.short: Embark on a cozy open-world adventure filled with vast landscape, mystical puzzles and unexpected platforming challenges. Dress up not just for style, but to unravel hidden mysteries, interact with a vibrant environment, and experience the freedom to explore at your own pace.
store.about:
In this game, Nikki and Momo embark on a new adventure, traveling across the fantastic nations of Miraland, each with its own unique culture and environment. Players will encounter many characters and whimsical creatures while collecting stunning outfits of various styles. Some of these outfits possess magical abilities essential for progressing through the story.

 Bright and fantasy-filled open world 
 The world of Infinity Nikki offers a refreshing escape from traditional apocalyptic landscapes. It's bright, whimsical, and filled with magical creatures. Wander through this wonderful land and explore the beauty and charm around every corner.

 Exceptional clothing design and dress-up experience 
 Express your style with an extensive collection of beautifully designed outfits, some of which even grant unique abilities. From floating and purifying to gliding and shrinking, these outfits unlock exciting new ways to explore the world and overcome challenges. Each outfit enriches your journey, letting you mix and match for the perfect look.

 Platforming with endless fun 
 In this vast, fantastic world, master skills like floating, running, and plunging to freely explore the land and tackle intricately designed puzzles and challenges. The joy of 3D platforming is seamlessly integrated into the game's open-world exploration. Each scene is vibrant and charming—from soaring paper cranes, speeding wine cellar carts, mysterious ghost trains—so many hidden secrets await discovery!

 Cozy sim activities and casual fun 
 Relax with activities like fishing, bug catching, or grooming...

store.name: Schedule I
store.short: From small-time dope pusher to kingpin - manufacture and distribute a range of drugs throughout the grungy city of Hyland Point. Expand your empire with properties, businesses, employees and more.
store.about:
Schedule I drugs, substances, or chemicals are defined as drugs with no currently accepted medical use and a high potential for abuse.
 - The Drug Enforcement Administration

You're a small-time drug dealer rolling into a fresh town with no cash, no product and no connections. Build your drug empire from the ground up in the grungy west-coast city of Hyland Point. Contend against intensifying law enforcement and deadly cartel competitors to expand your empire and reach the peak of the underworld.

Produce a range of drugs to satisfy your customers, each one with it's own unique production process. Discover special recipes to create new drug variants with special properties.

Walk, skate or drive throughout Hyland Point to get product into the hands of customers. Hire dealers to handle distribution for you.

Purchase new properties and hire employees to expand the scope and scale of your operations. Work with suppliers to build a fully automated production and distribution chain.

This is a dangerous line of work - you'll have to contend with increasing law enforcement , as well as deadly cartel competitors. Fight with fists, melee weapons or firearms .

A growing empire needs skilled management. Reach new heights in co-op multiplayer .

store.name: Water Maid
store.short: Water Maid is all about fetching water. Run, jump and dash to avoid enemies and find the elusive fresh water springs scattered around the island. Fill up your pot and make it back to the village, safe and sound.
store.about:
Fill Up Your Pot and Make it Back. Safely

Watermaids are all about heading out and bringing back fresh water for the villagers. Navigate treacherous terrain and evade enemies to find a springwater well. 

Fill up your trusty pot and return to the village before the sun sets. Be careful though, you're not as agile as you were before filling up. 

 Take Down Vicious Beasts and Explore the Island

Escape, Escort, and Strike Back. Outmaneuver cunning enemies and uncover the secrets of Nada Village Island. Investigate the disappearance of your predecessor and keep the villagers safe from the calamity that is to befall the island.

 Features

 Fluid parkour-like moves for wall jumping, dashing, sliding, and climbing

 A narrative-driven linear adventure inspired by Sri Lankan culture and folklore

 Chase sequences, boss battles, and time trials with a steady difficulty curve

 Death-stranding inspired hauling mechanics that impact player movement

store.name: On The Train
store.short: In a post-apocalyptic world overrun by zombies, your only sanctuary is a moving train. Build it into a powerful fortress, gather resources, and survive relentless challenges. Play solo or CO-OP, defend against zombie attacks, endure harsh survival conditions, and face this perilous journey together.
store.about:
In a post-apocalyptic world surrounded by zombies, your only hope is a moving train! Embark on a journey to build a powerful base, survive, and hold your ground in these dangerous lands. As you pass through abandoned places, you'll face terrifying moments and gather resources from every corner to stay alive. In this rapidly changing world, vigilance is your greatest ally!

 BUILD YOUR TRAIN 

 Build and expand your shelter aboard a train that can be stopped at will, allowing you to gather resources, scavenge, and explore whenever needed. As your journey progresses, turn this train into a resilient stronghold, adapting it to meet the demands of each new threat you face.

 SURVIVE 

 Hunger and thirst are just some of the challenges you’ll encounter. On this perilous journey, you must prepare for every hardship, pushing your limits to survive! Manage resources, heal your wounds, and brace yourself for relentless weather and terrain.

 LOOT Resources and CRAFT Gear to Survive! 

 Scavenge essential supplies from abandoned places, ruined buildings, and wild landscapes. Craft your own equipment to defend yourself against zombies and other dangers! Every new item you create brings you one step closer to surviving in this unforgiving world.

 Dive into an Exciting EXPLORATION Adventure! 
 Travel through uncharted lands with your train, discovering the remnants of civilization. At each stop, find valuable resources, uncover hidden secrets, and face the unknown. Every destination holds a new adventure and lurking danger!

 Survive Against ZOMBIES and Threats! 
 Fearlessly defend...

store.name: The Defiant
store.short: Heroic stories from the Chinese battlefields of World War II will be brought to life in the form of a FPS game.
store.about:
In those dark years, we had long grown accustomed to separation and death.
 The aggressors trampled our nation underfoot, leaving every inch of land engulfed in flames of war.
 We are the indomitable Northeast Anti-Japanese United Army, operating in the snowy forests of Northeast China.
 We are the unyielding underground radio operators during the desperate Isolated Island period in Shanghai.
 We are the formidable Canal Detachment, a spearhead seeking swift justice.
 We are the Great Wall built with flesh and blood, standing majestically atop the Taihang Mountains of North China.
 Take up arms! We are The Defiant!
 Scene: Back to Moments of Crisis in History 
 The land we set foot upon is soaked with the blood of heroes.
 From the bleak, snowy forests of Northeast China, to the heavily fortified streets and alleys of occupied towns, and to the treacherous villages behind enemy lines... Here, you will be immersed in the somber, tragic and volatile atmosphere of China's War of Resistance.

 Level: An Immersive Experience 
 Here, every tree, every blade of grass, every brick and stone bears silent witness to that turbulent and heroic era.

 Firearm: Every weapon is an echo of history. 
 What you hold is not merely a weapon, but a historical relic carrying the memories of battles fought nearly a century ago.
 The game features dozens of firearms, including a wide range of rifles, submachine guns, pistols and machine guns. There are the classic Hanyang 88 rifle, the legendary Mauser C96 and SIG Bergmann Model 1920, along with many other weapons that emerged throughout modern...

store.name: Motocross The Game
store.short: A hyper-realistic motocross simulator built by riders, for riders. Control bike and rider as two separate physics bodies, race online through matchmaking or private lobbies, and chase the clock on live global time-attack leaderboards. Assists let newcomers learn at their own pace.
store.about:
Motocross The Game is a competition-first motocross simulator, built by riders for riders. Real bike physics, real tracks and real opponents, starting on PC in Early Access, with PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S versions to follow.

 You don't steer a weight. You ride a machine. MTG simulates the bike and the rider as two separate physics bodies. Shift your body to lock the front wheel into a rut, load the rear for drive out of a berm, adjust your pitch mid-air, and throw whips and scrubs with real precision.

 The 250F and 450F each get their own engine, gearbox, suspension and power-delivery model, so they ride like two different animals.

 Built in Unreal Engine 5. From the hard-pack of Rödeby and the deep ruts of Midsummer Carnage to the sand of Pacific Crown, every layout asks for its own lines, braking points and setup. Dynamic lighting, detailed dirt rendering, and sound design that tells you what the bike is doing before you see it.

 Packed gates, every night. Line up on dedicated servers and race real opponents. Queue into matchmaking, or set up private, invite-only races for your crew or league.

 A Dual Rating System tracks your Skill Rating (pace and results) and your Safety Rating (track etiquette), so clean, fast riders end up racing each other.

 Ranked to the millisecond. Every time-attack track has a live global leaderboard per bike class, also visible on our website. Learn the line, shave the tenths, and put your name above the world's fastest. Regular challenges keep the board moving.

 Show up at the gate looking like you. Build your rider from helmet...

store.name: My Time at Evershine
store.short: Be the Governor of a brand-new settlement on the fringes of the Free Cities, facing the almighty Duvos Empire. Recruit settlers, build infrastructure, tame the wilds, and lead your people to become a new cornerstone for the Alliance in this adventure-packed simulation RPG!
store.about:
The third game of the My Time series. Evershine is a 3D open world Simulation RPG that takes place in a wholesome post-apocalyptic world 330 years after the Day of Calamity destroyed civilization. After surviving the nuclear winter for hundreds of years underground, people are finally picking up the piece again…

 The story takes place 3 years after the events of My Time at Sandrock and My Time at Portia. The Duvos Empire has taken over the Orzu Ruins which the Principality of Ethea also claims as their own, leading to a tense situation just north of the Alliance of Free Cities border in the Northern Eufaula region. The Alliance initiated the North Development Plan to move more settlers into the region in an effort to establish a new City State for a better defensive posture. It is calling on anyone interested in new opportunities to move to the region... 

 Develop romantic relationships with ten core, charming NPCs, including four chosen by backers' votes, and experience heart-pounding moments in every interaction. Beyond romance, you’ll meet over twenty unique NPCs, each with their own personality, ready to be part of your settlement. As you invite them in, you’ll forge deep, lasting bonds that grow stronger over time. 

 You’ll be playing as the Governor of the Evershine Settlement, recruited into the North Development Plan by the project’s Director, Mr. Gaudi. Your job will be to build up the infrastructure (either by prefabs or DIY), recruit the right settlers, tame the wilds, and build up your settlement into a strong presence next to the border. Along the way, you...

store.name: Golf With Your Friends 2
store.short: Golf With Your Friends is back, and this time it means fore. Up to 12 players, Chaos Mode, a new level editor, and enough questionable shots to end any friendship.
store.about:
Golf With Your Friends is back, and this time it means fore. 

 If you loved the first game, buckle up, you’re in for a hole lot more. New courses, new chaos, and enough ridiculous moments to make you question your friendship choices (in the best possible way).

 And if you’ve never played Golf With Your Friends before? Friend. Where have you been? Hiding in a bunker? It’s fine — you can jump straight in with everyone else soon. Very soon.

 Twelve. Players. Twelve. 
 More late nights. More arguments. More moments where someone sinks a hole-in-one by pure accident and won’t stop talking about it for the rest of the round. Whether you’re playing locally or cross platform, everyone’s invited.

 Introducing Chaos Mode, where the courses fight back! 
 Putt your way through remixed courses, where players who can adapt on the fly and embrace the chaos, come out on top. No two playthroughs are the same in this brand-new experience.

 Build the course of your (or someone else’s) nightmares 
 The revamped level editor (course creator) is now available on all platforms! Giving you more tools, more options, and more power to create courses that your friends will either applaud or never forgive you for. Build it, share it and take zero responsibility for what happens next.

 Golf With Your Friends 2. More modes, more mayhem, more reasons to question your life choices.
 Wishlist now.

store.name: Erosion
store.short: Your daughter's been kidnapped. Every death costs you a decade. Explore a roguelike open world where your actions reshape the timeline. Join a cult, steal a ride, gamble Cheddar. Collect 100+ weapons and abilities, demolish destructible voxel dungeons. Can you save her before time steals her away?
store.about:
Your daughter's been kidnapped by a warlord and dragged into the mysterious living Pillar that warps time itself. You're gonna get her back. The catch? When you die, the world jumps forward a decade, aging your daughter and changing the world around you.

 Die in a dungeon? Wake up ten years later. That peaceful farm is now a cultist compound worshipping the Great Ol' Rooster. That store owner you helped? They've built an empire. Your choices permeate across decades, transforming factions, townsfolk, and entire regions. Once you’ve mastered full timeline control, you can rewrite every possible future.

 Explore a massive wasteland overworld where you can join a cult, steal a slick new ride, and gamble your hard-earned Cheddar away at the Al Cashino. Go sand fishing for buried creatures, hunt bounties, try your luck in duels, or just race trucks through the salt flats. Complete quests to unlock permanent upgrades and reshape the future.

 Collect dozens of weapons from ritual bows that draw their strength from your blood, to homing smart guns, to the legendary Ebony Rooster that shoots bouncy eggs. Experiment with 100+ skills and modifiers to create absurd synergies. Command an army of cats. Deploy orbital turrets. Clone yourself. The build possibilities are endless.

 Destructible voxel environments mean cover is temporary and collateral damage is guaranteed. Blow up walls, turn locations into rubble, and flip the poker table! Physics-driven destruction meets bullet-hell combat for that sweet, sweet emergent mayhem.

store.name: Sandcastle
store.short: On a sun-warmed tropical shore, quietly craft a mighty sandcastle. Carve moats, raise towers and walls, then embellish with driftwood, pebbles, shells and seaweed. Gentle tides, soft surf and a calming color palette turn every build into a peaceful, relaxing moment.
store.about:
Sandcastle is the ultimate sandbox game. Unlock a variety of tools to gather wet sand, shape towering walls, carve intricate battlements, and engineer elaborate moats designed to withstand or divert the encroaching waves.

 No rush, just relax 
 There are no ticking clocks. Only the slow rhythm of the tide and the warm glow of the sun. Discover secret treasures washed ashore or buried deep into the sand, each adding a touch of personality to your sandy masterpiece.

 Physics simulation 
 Beneath the whimsy lies a unique water and sand physics simulation that brings your creations to life. Sand compacts, crumbles, and holds its shape depending on moisture and pressure, while waves flow, pool, and gently erode your walls just as they would in reality. Carve too thin and a tower may slump; reinforce with damp sand and it will stand proud against the tide. The result is a tactile, authentic sand castle crafting experience that feels just like building one on a real beach: sun-warmed, hands-on, and wonderfully satisfying.

 Beach customization 
 Collect starfishes to unlock customization options: Sand type, beach layout, size... Give your beach its own character and charm. Peaceful atolls ringed by turquoise waters, quiet lagoons with gentle shallows, sweeping sand barriers shaped by the breeze, and winding deltas where little streams meet the sea. Every shoreline offers a fresh canvas, inviting you to build, decorate, and relax in a new seaside setting.

 Features 
 Beaches with unique water and sand physic simulation

 Many tools to craft your castle with precision

 10...

store.name: KINGDOM HEARTS IV
store.short: Our hero Sora awakes in the unfamiliar world of Quadratum. As he looks for a way to return to his world, his friends Donald and Goofy head for the Underworld to try to find him. Wield the Keyblade in fast-paced battles that match to your own play style.
store.about:
As the KINGDOM HEARTS series approaches its 25th anniversary, a new adventure begins.

 Our hero Sora awakes in the unfamiliar world of Quadratum. As he looks for a way to return from this modern metropolis to his own world, his friends Donald and Goofy head for the Underworld in hopes of finding a clue to his whereabouts.

 The dynamic, fast-paced battle system allows you to effortlessly combine attacks and magic, as well as build combos with a brand-new battle feature.

 Change the Keyblade Sora wields to unleash unique attacks, matching the flow of battle to your own strategies and play style.

store.name: ArcheAge Chronicles
store.short: Explore Auroria, a vast and vibrant world brimming with rich lore and thrilling action. ArcheAge Chronicles delivers an immersive experience that will capture players' hearts, whether they are newcomers to the setting or seasoned adventurers.
store.about:
"Pioneer Your Path in Auroria, the Land of Opportunity" 

 ▶A World of Story and Adventure 

It is the Age of Pioneers. Auroria, a legend long forgotten, has been rediscovered. Now, many hopeful pioneers are headed to this distant land to make a name for themselves. As an experienced explorer, you will be taking your first steps into Auroria as a member of an established trading company. As you embark on this new adventure, you will explore ancient ruins, investigate a catastrophic airship crash, and become embroiled in the web of intrigue surrounding the mysterious and tragic event. Along the way you will meet many characters shrouded in mystery, each with their own secrets and goals. Who will help you and who will stand against you as you experience the unfolding story of Auroria in ArcheAge Chronicles?

 ▶Action-Packed Combat 

Experience intense battles that will keep you on the edge of your seat. ArcheAge Chronicles transcends traditional MMORPG mechanics with its fluid, sophisticated action combat. Choose from a variety of weapons and skills to create a unique build and overcome powerful foes. Explore a wide range of combat styles including close-quarters melee, deadly ranged attacks, and powerful magic. Engage dynamically as you jump, fall, roll, dash, block, and parry. No matter your preferred playstyle, ArcheAge Chronicles delivers a high-quality combat experience.

 ▶Unique Features and Innovations 

Engage in rich life skills content such as hunting, gathering, housing, farming, and crafting. Learn new recipes, trade with other players, and build a pioneer...

store.name: Melvor Idle 2: A RuneScape Adventure
store.short: Embark on a brand-new RuneScape idle adventure with Melvor Idle 2. Master iconic RuneScape Skills, face powerful Combat challenges, or uncover the history of the world via Quests, all while enjoying zen-like progression.
store.about:
Embark on a brand new adventure in Melvor Idle 2! 
 Melvor Idle 2  expands upon the beloved foundations of its predecessor and the wider world, to bring a deeper, richer, and more refined idle gaming experience. This  single-player  adventure lets you explore an ever-growing world of skills, combat, and strategy at your own pace.
 Whether you're a veteran of idle games, a fan of the original Melvor or a maxxed out RuneScape completionist,  Melvor Idle 2  offers a fresh adventure that balances depth with accessibility. It's the ultimate idle RPG for both busy adventurers and those ready to immerse themselves in a constantly evolving world

 Master Melvor’s many unique skills with just a click or a tap. Melvor Idle 2 is a feature-rich, idle/incremental game combining a distinctly RuneScape feel with a fresh gameplay experience. Maxing your skills has never been more zen! If you are looking for a deep but accessible adventure that easily fits around a busy lifestyle, then Melvor Idle 2 is an idle experience unlike any other.
 Every skill in this game serves a purpose, interacting with the others in interesting ways. This means all the hard work you put into one skill will in turn benefit others. What strategy will you conjure to achieve maximum skillage?
 It doesn’t just end with Woodcutting, Smithing, Cooking and Farming either – take your finely honed tapping abilities into battle and face off against monsters using your Melee, Ranged and Magic skills. Conquering brutal dungeons and toppling boisterous bosses has never been quite like this before…
 In addition to the skills...

store.name: TANUKI: Pon's Summer
store.short: The Tanuki Festival is just a month away, and the shrine is in disrepair. Follow Pon, a well meaning, if a bit lazy Tanuki with a part-time job at the Post Office, as he works to restore the shrine before summer ends. Deliver packages, make friends, and get the shrine ready for the big festival!
store.about:
Come spend a summer in Japan 
 A whole month on a sunlit Japanese island, and you get to spend it as a little tanuki on a bicycle. Meet Pon: part-time postal worker, enthusiastic show-off, and your invitation to a summer of small adventures and people you’ll hate saying goodbye to. There’s a festival to prepare for and mail to deliver, so you’re going to have a very full summer.

 Deliver mail, become a familiar face 
 Hop on your BMX, and bring letters and packages to the island’s colorful residents. Plan your delivery to fit all the awkwardly-shaped boxes on a bike, but don’t keep your neighbors waiting! As you learn your routes and get to know the people along them, the island begins to feel like your home. 

 Build the heart of your summer 
 Turn the money and rewards you’ve earned into a shrine worth falling in love with. Rebuild, upgrade and decorate it to your taste, watching your work come together as the Great Tanuki Festival approaches. Pon wants to do a good job. For all his showing off on that bicycle, he cares very much about the people here. When the Great Tanuki Festival arrives, you’ll have somewhere special to welcome the people you’ve spent the season getting to know. 

 You’re invited. To pretty much everything.
 Getting to know the locals comes with an increasingly tempting list of invitations. Make sushi, join a baseball game, step into the sumo ring, and discover what else your new friends have going on. Every activity brings opportunities to earn rewards for the shrine, and another reason to get attached to the people who live here.

 Be adorable....
