 Features: 
 Your own bongo cat
 Many customization options
 A friend while working hard
 Based on the artwork and meme of @StrayRogue and @DitzyFlama

store.name: Shark Dentist
store.short: Shark Dentist is a unique horror roguelike where you play as a shark dentist. Your task is to treat the teeth of giant predators in a dark clinic while avoiding their deadly aggression. Balance tactics, luck, and limited resources to heal your patient without losing your own life.
store.about:
Key Features:

 Intense Gameplay: Treat a shark's teeth without waking it. Every mistake can lead to deadly consequences.

 Roguelike Mechanics: Randomly generated dental issues, tools, and debuffs make each attempt unique.

 Multitasking: Monitor the shark's pulse, maintain oxygen supply, manage anesthesia, and choose the right tools.

 Realistic Tool Interaction: Use syringes, drills, mirrors, and even a circular saw to tackle various tasks.

 Organic Balance: Manage the shark's stress level by finding a balance between the pain of treatment and limited resources.

 Your Main Enemies:
 Shark Stress: Higher stress brings the shark closer to waking.

 Limited Resources: Be cautious with your supply of anesthetic and tools.

 Random Events: Equipment failures, sudden pain spikes, and other surprises.

 The game will appeal to horror fans, streamers, and lovers of films like Jaws , The Meg , and Saw . If you enjoy challenging games with random elements and a tense atmosphere, Shark Dentist will become your new favorite.
 Can you stay calm and survive while doing your job? Find out in Shark Dentist !

store.name: ORMOD: Directive
store.short: Shape your own survival experience in an infinite open-world sandbox. Customize world difficulty, rules, and playstyle. Play solo, co-op, or on 24/7 MMO-style servers across PvP, PvE, Hardcore, or Creative modes as you build, automate, fight, and survive. The choice is yours.
store.about:
BUILD. AUTOMATE. FIGHT. SURVIVE. 
 A fully customizable, harsh open-world survival sandbox set in a world overtaken by the ORMOD. Start in an infinite world that changes every playthrough, then tailor the experience to your liking, from world rules and difficulty to whether you play solo, co-op, or on larger persistent 24/7 servers.
 FEATURE OVERVIEW: 
 Infinite, fully customizable procedural worlds

 Choose your experience: solo, co-op, or large persistent servers

 Multiple modes, including PvP, PvE, Hardcore, Creative, and mini-games

 Player-defined difficulty and world settings

 Physical and persistent item simulation

 Unique tile-based base building

 Full automation and mega-factory construction

 Realistic combat and advanced ballistic simulation

 Deep survival mechanics (health, sickness, temperature, farming, etc.)

 Skills, quests, and a dynamic player-driven economy

 Dynamic world events: crash sites, airdrops, global PvP encounters

 Vehicles with realistic handling and manual gear systems

 Nighttime mechanoid hunts that challenge any playstyle

 INFINITE AND FULLY CUSTOMIZABLE WORLDS 
 No two playthroughs are the same. Every session generates new towns, buildings, roads, and terrain layouts, allowing players to shape their own survival experience from the ground up. 
 PLAY SOLO, WITH FRIENDS, OR ON 24/7 SERVERS 
 Choose exactly how you want to play. Tweak world difficulty, customize rules, and decide whether you explore alone, host private sessions with friends, or join larger 24/7 persistent servers. Play PvP, PvE, Hardcore, Creative, mini-games, or...

store.name: I Have No Change
store.short: “I Have No Change” is a first-person narrative game that immerses players in the atmosphere of a night kiosk filled with stories, melancholia, and the reflections of residents from Russia’s regions.
store.about:
Winter. New Year's Eve. A night kiosk.  

 This is where 27-year-old Matvey works, serving all kinds of customers — from familiar faces to wandering strangers. 
On the other side of the kiosk’s window, their stories unfold: about good and bad, life and death, how Vitya cheated on Masha, and how the building on Stroiteley Street is once again without hot water.

 During these festive nights, alone with his thoughts, Matvey keeps asking himself:
 How did he end up in this kiosk? Did he ever dream of such a life? Is he ready for change? 

 Let’s step into Matvey’s world and see how a vast universe fits within this small kiosk.

 “I Have No Change” — a first-person narrative-driven game that combines: 
 A grounded, slice-of-life dramatic narrative 

 A quiet, personal story that lingers long after it ends, touching on stagnation, lost dreams, and fragile hopes;
 Premium visual presentation 

 Realistic visuals with a strong focus on detail and colour, deepening the sense of place and narrative immersion;
 Expressive characters 

 Brought to life by real actors. Most of them have their own story – warm, melancholic, or quietly reflective;
 Thematic soundtrack 

 Music and songs by local artists enhance the emotional connection to the story and shape the atmosphere of each scene.

store.name: Cinema Theater Tycoon
store.short: Tycoon game where you manage your movie theater through more than 100 years of history. Build and customize your cinematic empire without being overtaken by the evolution of the 7th art.
store.about:
Cinema is your empire 
 Start your journey in 1906 in Paris, just after the first screenings by the Lumière brothers, and thrive for more than 100 years of cinematic evolution. Whether managing a small independent cinema or the world's most prestigious theater, every decision you make will shape the future of your business.

 Design the cinema of your dreams 
 In Cinema Theater Tycoon, customization is at the heart of your success. Build and modify every aspect of your cinemas, from floor to ceiling, with hundreds of items. Create unique screening rooms, upgrade your equipment, and choose every detail with precision.

 A journey through 100 years of movie magic 
 Relive the key moments in cinema history. From silent films to modern blockbusters, each era is represented with its movies, technologies, and trends. Cult classics, world premieres, and seasonal events will bring your cinema to life across the decades. Host premieres, masterclasses, and film clubs to attract stars and moviegoers.

 Manage, optimize, expand 
 Manage every aspect of your cinema, from programming to staff, ticket and popcorn prices, and ensure your theaters are always ready for the next big premiere. Send your film buyers across the globe to find THE perfect movie.

store.name: VOID DIVER: Escape from the Abyss
store.short: Dive into a city swallowed by the Abyss. Slay aberrations, grab artifacts, and survive until the Diving Booth arrives. A 2.5D pixel art extraction action RPG with up to 3-player co-op. Run the antique shop 'BALUSHA' and uncover the city's secrets.
store.about:
'Void Diver: Escape from the Abyss' is a 2.5D pixel art extraction action RPG: dive into a city swallowed by the otherworld, recover artifacts, and make it out alive.
 Alone or with friends, fight through dungeons teeming with aberrations and madness, grab what you can, and call the Diving Booth to get out. All for the sake of completing your requests and returning alive.

 DIVE TOGETHER: Up to 3-Player Co-op 

 Party Play: Team up to take on dungeons and bosses, with everyone's skills colliding on the same screen.

 Diverse Divers: Choose from Divers with unique skills and stories, each offering a different combat style.

 Or Go Solo: Prefer the lone-wolf life? Explore the depths on your own.

 EXPLORE & EXTRACT: Escape the Distorted City 

 Otherworldly City: Police stations, hospitals, bus stops, parks... explore familiar cityscapes fused with another dimension.

 Artifact Recovery: From super-scientific devices to forbidden magic relics, find the valuables hidden throughout the dungeon.

 Extraction: Call the Diving Booth and hold out until the countdown ends. Only then do you make it home with your loot.

 SURVIVAL: Aberrations, Madness, and Curses 

 Bosses That Rule Each District: Urban legends, rampaging machines, and humans driven to madness. Read their patterns and survive.

 Mental Pressure: Dungeons consume not just the body, but the mind. Manage the stress that triggers strange phenomena when it hits its limit.

 The Paradox Curse: Survival includes finding cures for 'Paradoxes', dreadful curses that linger even after an expedition.

 GROWTH: Build Your Own...

store.name: METAMORPHOSIS
store.short: Trapped in a dead world, a forsaken nun walks the long road to absolution. Branded a sinner, you must traverse megastructures, fight demons, and journey towards the last paradise.
store.about:
Explore the ruins of a dead world as Aria , a forsaken nun seeking absolution for her sins.

 METAMORPHOSIS is set in a future where humanity has manufactured its own rapture .
The surface of the Earth has long since collapsed due to war and decay , leaving nothing but silence below.
 The story begins as Aria descends into the depths; driven by guilt, by faith, and by something she cannot escape . The harsh, decaying world is full of atrocities and violence , and amidst the ruins and brutal encounters - could the answer to salvation really still be here? 

 Face off against a variety of foes , decrepit automatons, and pitiful mockeries of “rebirth” in deliberate, high-risk combat . Solve challenging puzzles, manage dwindling resources, and fight the remnants of an endless war.

 Explore large, interconnected areas filled with vertical spaces, hidden paths, and shortcuts. Wield firearms and powerful miracles to survive what lurks within.

 Interact with divine systems left behind. Confess yours sins but be careful who may be listening. 

 Speak with demons born both natural, and man-made. The follies you entertain, and the answers you take to heart may affect more than you think.

 Find meaning in a broken world. 

 -----
 You held your hands in prayer 
 Hiding inside your own faith . 
 You wished for only one thing: 
 To never see her again.

store.name: Kena: Scars of Kosmora
store.short: Kena’s journey to cure her affliction leads to the island of Kosmora, plagued by its own mysterious corruption. To protect Kosmora, she must master the elements with the aid of spirit companions and dynamic combat in this action-packed yet heartfelt adventure.
store.about:
Kena’s next adventure from the award-winning studio, Ember Lab

 Kena, now an accomplished Spirit Guide, travels to the mysterious island of Kosmora seeking a cure for her affliction and to reconnect with a friend from her past.

 Her search uncovers a forgotten, dangerous form of Spirit Guiding and introduces Kena to Spirit Companions – whose powers she will harness to solve puzzles and defeat enemies using new elemental skills.

 In Kena: Scars of Kosmora, explore a vibrant island full of buried secrets, wandering spirits, epic bosses, and distinct cultures. Awaken ancient temples bound to Kosmora’s hidden past to cleanse a powerful corruption consuming the land.

 Embark on Kena’s next adventure 
 Play as Kena, a Spirit Guide, who helps corrupted spirits struggling to pass on. Explore a rich world in this story driven action-adventure game featuring fast-paced combat. 

 Evolving Spirit Companions 
 Partner with elemental Spirit Companions that will aid you on your journey. Grow their powers and harness their abilities to solve puzzles, battle enemies, and traverse Kosmora. 

 Face Kosmora’s threats 
 Master new elemental abilities and powerful Spirit Guide techniques to overcome treacherous and diverse combat encounters leading up to epic bosses. 

 Explore a beautiful island full of secrets and danger 
 Travel to the mysterious island of Kosmora. Explore vibrant regions, each with their own distinct communities, and learn about the island’s forgotten past as you uncover secrets buried long ago.

store.name: Youtubers Life 3
store.short: Live the experience of becoming the best content creator of the moment. Start from scratch, create epic VODs, share your best moments on Instalife, build your dream house, and overcome challenges as you forge your path to fame. Welcome to the Youtuber life!
store.about:
Take your first step toward fame and experience 100% Youtubers Life , where every decision shapes your path. Start from scratch by creating VOD videos, sharing your best moments on Instalife, and overcoming challenges that will test your talent. Face off against rivals, gain followers, and prove you have what it takes to become the content creator you’ve always dreamed to be .

 It starts in an empty room and ends with a fully customized legendary house with a swimming pool, a cinema, your car collection and much more... Only you set the limit! 

 If you want to climb fast in the rankings, don't forget to upgrade your PC and recording equipment, and buy new consoles to increase the results of your VODs. You can also hire employees: editors, financiers, or personal trainers to be more productive! 

 When you become a popular star , the main brands will want you to be their image ambassador. Meet and negotiate with the most important companies of the moment and get the best possible conditions!

 As your fame grows, you will be able to attend more and better events . Check your calendar and sign up for the ones you find most interesting. You'll be able to get unique items and interact with other youtubers from around the world to expand your network. Connect with other talents, make new friends, and who knows maybe something more... ;p

store.name: ReBlade: The Death Spiral
store.short: You are a condemned Synthetic, marked for destruction and trapped in endless resets. In a cyberpunk world inspired by Chinese mythology, harness weapons, chips, and augments to cut through mechanical creatures. Each run brings you closer to breaking the cycle and unravelling the truth.
store.about:
You are a condemned Synthetic marked for destruction.
 Combine weapons, chips, and augments to forge your own path through endless resets. 
Slay mechanical creatures — and rip the truth out of this cyber-mythic city. 
 MASTER THE RHYTHM OF COMBAT 
 Combat in ReBlade is built around timing and control. 
Balance offense and defense, read enemy behavior, and strike at the right moment to seize the advantage.

 SHAPE YOUR BUILD, BREAK PAST LIMITS 
 Each run lets you refine how you fight.
Combine weapons, chips, and augments to shape your build, adapt to new challenges, and push further with every cycle.

 ENCOUNTER BEASTS, SURVIVE THE TRIALS 
 Ancient creatures, twisted and reinforced by machinery, stand in your way.
Study their patterns, break their defenses, and carve a bloody path to victory.

 DEFY YOUR FATE 
 Bound to an endless cycle of destruction, you are forced to repeat, learn, and resist.
Meet allies, trade the resources you uncover, and piece together the hidden truth of this world.

store.name: Transport Fever 3
store.short: Transport Fever 3, the ultimate transport tycoon returns, bigger, deeper, and more dynamic than ever. Build the routes that transform the world across land, sea, and sky using over a century of evolving transport options. Design and build your ideal transport network.
store.about:
Plan, build, and optimize! Transport Fever 3 puts you in charge of your own transport empire. From humble beginnings with horse-drawn wagons, steam trains, and paddle-steamers working towards the latest jet planes, supertankers, high-speed trains, and helicopters, you will build the network that drives the world!
 Every delivery earns money, while every train, truck, plane, or ship increases your costs. You’ll plan and build profitable routes, balance infrastructure expenses, and invest in upgrades to stay ahead of growing demand.
 With success comes the financial freedom to expand your reach, while earning the right to build world famous landmarks to demonstrate your achievements. Fall short, and you’ll be seeking efficiencies and improvements to propel your company forward.
 As your influence expands, the needs of every city become more challenging to fulfill. There's no such thing as one plan that works forever, you will need to adapt, overcome, and solve problems as they come up, balancing your desire for growth with the needs of the populations you serve.

 BECOME THE TYCOON 
 Build your personal transport empire by creating perfect routes to maximise your profits. Ensure that cargo and people get where they need to be, when they need to be. Manage and optimize your vehicle fleet, balance maintenance costs, efficiency, and priorities. Resolve bottlenecks and meet the evolving demands of dynamic towns and a multitude of industries that operate on- and offshore. Develop commercial centers, industrial powerhouses, and commuter cities by specializing deliveries and...

store.name: Ashes of the Singularity II
store.short: In this massive RTS game, command vast armies fighting for control of entire worlds. Control the forces of Earth, the mechanical AI Substrate, or the enigmatic Post-Human Coalition as you battle across the solar system in single player, cooperative multiplayer, or competitive multiplayer.
store.about:
Rise from the Ashes 
 In Ashes of the Singularity II players must choose between humanity, AI Substrate, or the Post-Human Coalition to determine the fate of our solar system. Speed and reflexes will not win the day, but rather the player’s ability to plan and execute powerful strategies to put forces and materials in the right place at the right time.

 Massive Armies, Vast Battlefields 
 Command thousands of units in real time across continent sized battlefields. Use Strategic Zoom to orchestrate movements from orbit to frontline and shape the terrain as you fight—not just to conquer, but to restore. As structures crumble and terrain turns to or from Turinium, witness the real-time transformation of warzones into reminders of your impact.
 Play Solo or Online 
 Campaign – Lead humanity with the United Earth Forces against Post-Human expansion and Substrate machinations in a story rooted in a frighteningly familiar, near future scenario of survival and restoration.

 Multiplayer – Join friends or rivals in PvP or co-op battles online.

 Instant Action - Pick the battlefield of your choice and take on computer-controlled opponents designed by some of the most experienced RTS developers in the industry.

 The War for the Soul of the Solar System 
 Enter epic battles where every faction fights for control of contested worlds. In instant action or multiplayer, command the humans of the United Earth Forces, the relentless constructs of the Post-Human Coalition, or the overwhelming AI Substrate, each with unique units, strategies, and philosophies that redefine how battles are...

store.name: Hillthorn
store.short: A disappearance in a secluded community. A mountain hiding its secrets. A detective running out of time. Welcome to Hillthorn, a dark investigation game that invites you to uncover the mystery without a single word spoken, using your skills of logic and intuition through cards.
store.about:
Only the foolish and the desperate attempt to wander the mazelike trails of Hillthorn. Even those who know their way may still stumble upon dangerous wildlife or a local villager’s piercing gaze. But a child has gone missing, time is in short supply, and you’re the one being tasked with unraveling the mountain’s secrets. Welcome to Hillthorn, a dark investigation game unlike any other, where the mystery unfolds without a single word spoken.

 A World in Cards 
 Every eerie and unsettling detail of Hillthorn's story is revealed entirely through Clue cards, which can be Investigated, Explored or in some instances Talked to in your search to get closer to truth behind the disappearance.

 You Are an Outsider 
 You've been tasked to find a missing person, though it’ll take some finesse to draw information from the locals, who seem reluctant to share details with someone outside their flock.

 Time is in Short Supply 
 The clock is ticking. There are too many threads to follow and too little time. Something seems keen on letting you revisit untrodden paths, but at what cost? 

 Features 
 Discover a strange mountain and uncover its secrets. 

 Card-based investigation with no dialogue. 

 The clock ticks with every action. 

 Short, atmospheric mystery. 

 Multiple endings to discover 

 Knowledge as progression. 

 No Generative AI

store.name: Drownlight
store.short: Drownlight is a city-building survival simulator set in a flooded world. Build and expand your city around a lighthouse, manage resources, and make moral decisions that shape the fate of the survivors. Secrets lurk in the raging waters, and if the lighthouse goes out, the city may be lost forever.
store.about:
When the world drowned, only the light remained 
 After a cataclysm that swallowed continents and erased civilization, a handful of survivors discover a solitary lighthouse standing above the endless ocean. Around its glow, humanity makes its last stand.
 You are their leader, the one who must rebuild, protect, and guide the final city of humankind.
 The Lighthouse: The Heart of Survival 
 Your lighthouse is more than a beacon. It’s life itself.
  🔹 Keep the Flame Alive – Generate power, gather fuel, and manage what little remains of the old world. If the light dies, people vanish into the darkness.
 🔹 A Beacon for the Lost – The light draws drifters from across the sea. Each new survivor brings labor, stories, and hope, but also new mouths to feed.
 🔹 Guard the Light, Fear the Depths – The ocean hides ancient secrets and unknown dangers waiting beyond the beam’s reach.
 Survive the Unforgiving Ocean 

 ⚫ The Darkness – The lighthouse must never fail, or you risk losing people to an unseen force that lurks beyond the light.
🌊 Unforgiving Weather – Face devastating storms that tear apart your structures and dead calms that starve your city of resources.
🎣 Resource Scarcity – Manage food, energy, and morale as supplies dwindle and the sea grows more hostile.
  ⚖ Choices That Shape Humanity – Decide who to save, who to sacrifice, and what kind of world is worth rebuilding.
 Key Features 
 🏗 Radial City-Building – Expand your city outward from the lighthouse, constructing and optimizing structures in a dynamic, ever-growing settlement.
⚖ Moral Dilemmas – Survivors will...

store.name: Wuthering Waves
store.short: Wuthering Waves is a story-rich open-world action RPG with a high degree of freedom. You wake from your slumber as Rover, joined by a vibrant cast of Resonators on a journey to reclaim your lost memories and change the world.
store.about:
Wuthering Waves is a story-rich open-world action RPG with a high degree of freedom. You wake from your slumber as Rover, joined by a vibrant cast of Resonators on a journey to reclaim your lost memories and change the world.

 Welcome aboard, roving voyager.
 Upon the shores lay the silent embers of a world during the Ebb Tide.
 Desolated by the Lament, the erstwhile creations and earthly beings are left static.
 But they strike back, strong enough to penetrate the silence.
 Humanity has risen anew from the ashes of the apocalypse.
 And you, Rover, are poised for an adventure of Awakening.
 Companions to meet, enemies to conquer, new powers to gain, hidden truths to unveil, and unseen spectacles to behold... A vast world of endless possibilities awaits. The choice rests in your hands. Be the answer, be the leader, and follow the sounds to arrive at a new future.
 As Wuthering Waves echo endlessly, mankind set sail on a new journey.
 Rise and embark on your odyssey, Rover.
 Delve into an expansive world / Desolated by the Lament, civilization is born anew
 Embrace high degrees of freedom in immersive overworld explorations. Free yourself from stamina limits, dash and parkour on walls, take Flight, and ride a high-mobility expedition motorbike to enjoy open-world exploration. As the world of Solaris-3 unfolds, your lost memory begins to see its recovery through this ceaseless quest.

 Enjoy extreme battle experience / Engage in smooth & fast-paced combat 
 Avail against enemy attacks in smooth and fast-paced combat. Apply easy controls of Extreme Evasion, Dodge Counter,...

store.name: Tenebyss
store.short: You are a scout of the True Order, an authoritarian regime ruling Teneria. Before you lies a vast realm of ruins, dungeons, and guarded towns, each with their own unique identity. Uncover the secrets of the realm with friends, or venture out alone.

store.name: Frostrail
store.short: Through the frost, death follows the tracks. Dive into a ruthless survival FPS, solo or co-op. Explore, scavenge, craft and fight to endure a frozen, corrupted world. Operate and upgrade your steam-powered train through an unforgiving wasteland, where every choice is a matter of survival.
store.about:
Once a mighty empire, the land now lies barren, consumed by an unrelenting cold. Twisted by the Emperor’s pact with the Void, its ruins are haunted by relentless revenants and eldritch horrors. Aboard an armored, steam-powered train, the Penitent Gardeners purge the land of the cursed, granting mercy to the lost and striking down the wicked, seeking salvation in the heart of the frozen desolation.

Your train is more than a refuge, it is your only way forward. As you explore the frozen wasteland, it will keep you moving and alive, carrying everything you need to survive. Fuel the Eden Engine, manage its power, and operate your train to explore further, scavenging what little remains of this world.

As your struggle grows heavier, so must your train. Reinforce its walls, craft weapon stations, and upgrade the engine to outpace the horrors that hunt you. Expand with new carriages, crafting stations and storage, forging a moving fortress against the cold and the terrors beyond.

Beyond the tracks lies a world frozen in death, its ruins entombed in ice and time. Explore the wasteland for vital supplies, scavenge the remnants of abandoned settlements, and break into wreckage lost to the frost. Descend into treacherous depths where greater rewards come at a deadly cost.

But the cold is unforgiving, and every step away from your train is a gamble. Risk death for precious supplies or stay safe and go without. The frost creeps into your bones, the blizzard blinds, slows, and suffocates. Heat is survival, ration it wisely. And in the silence of the snow, something else stirs…

Face...

store.name: Demon Bluff
store.short: The cards lie! In this single-player social deduction game, demons have infiltrated your village and disguised themselves as allies. Every card you turn over is either a friend or a foe. Can you see through their bluff?
store.about:
The cards lie! In this single-player social deduction game, demons have infiltrated your village and disguised themselves as allies. Every card you turn over is either a friend or a foe. Can you see through their bluff?

 A ROGUELIKE CARD GAME WHERE YOUR DECK IS FULL OF LIES 
 Demon Bluff combines the tension of social deduction games with the replay value of a single-player roguelike deckbuilder.
 Your goal is to investigate a corrupted village, gather information from each character, and piece together the truth to uncover and slay every demon in hiding.
 Each character is represented by a card - Villager and Outcast cards will help you track them down with information and unique abilities. But be careful -  Demons and Minions have disguised themselves as Villagers and will try to mislead you. Will you be able to see through their lies?

 MANY MODES TO MASTER 
 Face the lies and save multiple corrupted villages in one run, with an expanding deck of randomized cards. Or, draft your own in Deckbuilding mode - then conquer a multi-part run where you’ll encounter new and increasingly complex cards, upgrades, and lies as you progress. Plus - test yourself with endless mode, challenges, and more.

 EXPAND, UNLOCK, AND CUSTOMIZE 
 Keep saving villages and unlock dozens of new character cards to expand your deck or encounter in randomized runs. Then, customize them with alternate skins, card backs, and decorations you’ll collect as you play.

 FEATURES: 
 100+ unique character cards to collect

 Cosmetic unlocks and customization

 Increasingly complex mechanics and challenges

store.name: HAEX
store.short: An anomaly has been detected in the sub-arctic north. The science team sent to investigate has gone missing. Survive an alien-scarred wilderness solo or with up to 3 friends. Push back the mist, reshape the world, craft weapons and gear, and fight to unearth what happened.
store.about:
A co-op survival shooter for 1-4 players 
 In this procedural open-world action-adventure, your character and worlds are saved separately. Unlock new gear, acquire skills and find crafting recipes that you can take anywhere. Start a new world for a fresh adventure, or jump into a friend's game fully geared up. Every world keeps its own story. Every character keeps its own progression.

 An extraterrestrial power journey 
 Discover a sentient cube that allows you to effortlessly gather resources and scan your surroundings. Upgrade it to level up its capabilities. Unlock powerful alien abilities as you progress, opening up new ways to traverse the world with moves like dashing and double-jumping.

 Plant alien seeds to reshape a sub-arctic open world  
 Find or craft alien seeds that let you transform your world, and open new possibilities. Planting them unlocks unique new areas and resources, but beware of the new threats you might unleash on your world.

 Find the science expedition that went silent in the mist 
 Unearth what happened. The further you go the more dangerous the world becomes. Meet a cast of characters across the world, each with their own insights about the events unfolding around you. 

 Survive the cold and build your survival skills  
 Cold kills. Hunger slows you down. Go too deep without the right gear and you won't come back. Enemies, resources, and secrets all evolve with depth, and so do the rewards. Discover and explore alien structures in your search for more skills to unlock and weapons to craft.  

 Tune your loadout for what’s stalking the next...

store.name: PEAK
store.short: PEAK is a co-op climbing game where the slightest mistake can spell your doom. Either solo or as a group of lost nature scouts, your only hope of rescue from a mysterious island is to scale the mountain at its center. Do you have what it takes to reach the PEAK?
store.about:
PEAK is a co-op climbing game where the slightest mistake can spell your doom. Either solo or as a group of lost nature scouts, your only hope of rescue from a mysterious island is to scale the mountain at its center. Do you have what it takes to reach the PEAK?

 WORK TOGETHER 
 Need a Hand? You’ll need to rely on your friends to have any hope of scaling the mountain, which changes every single day. Help each other up ledges, or place ropes and climbing spikes to make the way easier for those who come after.

 CLIMB 
 The Mountain Takes no Prisoners! Climb through 4 biomes on your way to the PEAK, each with their own life-threatening obstacles. You’ll need to scavenge for questionable food to survive, and manage your injuries carefully - every setback limits your stamina, making it harder to climb.

 SURVIVE 
 Prepare For the Worst: Discover a variety of helpful survival items, from energy drinks to climbing spikes to the mysterious Anti-Rope. You’ve got no hope of making it to the PEAK unless you press every advantage given to you.

 A NEW ISLAND EACH DAY 
 The game's map rotates out every 24 hours! Try out the new layout each day, or give the same island multiple attempts in a day until you conquer it.

 EARN BADGES 
 A Well-Seasoned Scout: Show off your survival prowess with dozens of badges to earn and cosmetics to unlock.

 CLIMBING IS BETTER WITH FRIENDS 
 Multiplayer in PEAK is friends-only - invite up to three other scouts online to climb together, or face the mountain alone if you're really brave!

 FEATURES 
 Online, cross-platform co-op and offline single...

store.name: Astral Hunter: Homebound
store.short: A top-down action roguelite where you capture pets and battle alien hordes. Choose your weapons and combine upgrades and items to create your own combat style. Capture alien creatures to use their abilities or bring them to your base for materials. Recruit new characters and conquer the planet!
store.about:
Hello, Starseekers! We're Mosscat, a two-person indie development team. We're excited to bring you this fast-paced action roguelike game! 

 Keep upgrading and customizing your equipment and skills as you fight. Mix and match 8 unique weapons, 8 skills, and 120 weapon modules. Strategically purchase special items and deliberately sacrifice stats you don't need. Play to your strengths, work around your weaknesses, and create a combat style that's truly your own! 

 Take on 25 stages, 25 types of monsters, and 7 powerful bosses! Capture all kinds of creatures you encounter in battle and put their abilities to good use. Pick the best specimens and bring them back to your base to build a ranch, where they'll continuously produce valuable materials for you. (Even while you're away!) 

 Use resources produced by your ranch creatures to strengthen yourself. Absorb the essence of all things and combine 121 unique items to transform yourself from the inside out. Every essence you absorb brings you one step closer to an even more powerful form!

store.name: Retro Rewind - Video Store Simulator
store.short: Manage your very own video store in the early 90s! Rent, sell, decorate and expand your business from the ground up and relive the golden ages of movie and video game rentals!
store.about:
Relive the golden ages of video rentals by opening your very own video store. Rent, sell, organize and build your business from the ground up. Hire staff, manage your team and become the best rental destination in town!

 From taking reservations and charging late fees to recommending movies and preparing delicious snacks, there’s never a dull moment when running your store!

 Customize your walls and floors, decorate with posters and memorabilia and expand your layout to build the video store of your dreams.

 Fill your shelves with thousands of unique movies and video games, each with their own title, genre and hand-drawn cover art! Order them on your old PC or buy exclusive bootleg films from the shady Tape Dealer. Each week will have new releases inspired by real iconic hits of the 80s and 90s.  

 Additional   Game Features: 
 Build Your Dream Team: Hire staff to give you a hand on daily tasks to run your store.

 Manage Your Returns:  Check-in returns in the system, rewind tapes and set aside reserved movies and games for your customers.

 Charge Late & Broken Fees: Keep track of late and damaged returns, charge fees and handle customer complaints.

 Ban Customers: Use the Customer Profile system to ban troublesome customers and gradually improve your store's clientele.

 Evolving Customer Interactions: Seasons, weather and holidays affect gameplay and what your customers rent! Be ready, rainy Friday nights are crazy busy in the store!

 Seasons & Festivals: Play through all four seasons as the environment transforms around you. Each season features special holidays...

store.name: Blue Archive
store.short: An action anime RPG adventure!
store.about:
This game contains some suggestive images and dialogue that may not be suitable for all ages and access may be restricted for users in certain age groups. 
 =========================================================================
 Embark on an adventure with the girls of this epic anime fantasy RPG, Blue Archive, and dive into its world of strategic combat, brought to life by stunning animations. Your journey through Kivotos will be one filled with victory and loss, love and heartbreak, all alongside an unforgettable, touching story. Build strong, deep relationships and get to know each student's unique story while leading your squad. So let's go, Sensei!

 ■A Fantasy-Filled Anime RPG You'll Never Forget!
 Step into Kivotos and your adventure as a teacher will begin. Experience a story of love and friendship with stunning cinematics, in both 2D and 3D animation. Throughout your journey, you'll meet and befriend the students of this world, learning their unique stories and motivations. Each girl plays a vital role in the story: building strong bonds, forming squads to protect those they love, and creating heartwarming memories with Sensei!

 ■Lead Elite Anime Girls into Battle in this Tactical RPG Experience!
 Form a squad with the girls you meet, each contributing their own unique combat elements. Adapt your strategies throughout the adventure to lead them to victory! With stunning animation and 3D cinematics, Blue Archive's combat is a blend of strategy and rich visuals.

 ■Foster Bonds with the Girls in Relationship Stories!
 Every girl in Blue Archive has her own story...

store.name: Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis
store.short: Experience a stunning reimagining of Lara Croft’s debut adventure to discover the lost secrets of Atlantis with jaw-dropping visuals, modern gameplay, and new surprises that honor the spirit of the original.
store.about:
Experience the pinnacle of adventure with Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis, a stunning reimagining of the 1996 genre-defining game.
 As Lara Croft, harness your wits and athleticism to explore exotic locations lost to time—from the jungles of Peru to the ancient ruins of Greece, the deserts of Egypt, and a mysterious Mediterranean island shrouded in myth. Traverse treacherous landscapes, solve deadly contraptions, and face lethal predators as you hunt for the scattered pieces of the Scion, an artifact of immeasurable power.
 Whether you're a veteran raider or new to Lara's world, Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis delivers jaw-dropping visuals powered by Unreal Engine 5, modern game design, and new surprises, while honoring the spirit and atmosphere of Lara Croft's debut adventure.

store.name: Swords & Slippers
store.short: A character action roguelite set in a twisted fairytale. These princesses don't want a rescue - they want the heads of the evil stepmothers who stole their happily ever after. Come for the curves. Stay for the combos.
store.about:
Stepmothers took the thrones. Princesses took up arms. Swords & Slippers is old-school character action with a roguelite kick. Fight as a squad of the fairytale heroines you know: reimagined, weaponized, and yours to lead.
 LOOK GOOD DOING IT
 Your attacks branch into deep combo routes, every hit landing with a satisfying crunch. Defense keeps you dangerous, while the style meter rewards creativity. Swap between your heroines mid-combo, never drop the chain, and look gorgeous while the body count climbs.

 EVERY PRINCESS IS A WEAPON
 Snow White crushes foes with a dwarven pickaxe. Red Hood is the wolf of her own story. Rapunzel's hair has a mind - and a mouth - of its own. No two heroines fight alike, and the roster grows alongside the rebellion.
 STEPMOTHERS DON'T FIGHT FAIR
 Armored knights and twisted creatures are only the beginning. Survive long enough, and you'll come face to face with the storybook legends of your childhood, reimagined as bosses built to break you.
 POWER UP BEFORE MIDNIGHT
 Every run begins at dawn. Arm your heroines with elemental powers and unleash them through skillful combat. Earn new powers and grow stronger as the hours pass. You'll need everything you've got by midnight, when enemies are deadliest and rewards richest.

 CHARMING HAS WORK TO DO
 Between runs, the heroines come home to the castle - and to you, Prince Charming. Win their trust, uncover their secrets, and let your choices shape each heroine's story. Romance them if you like - but mind your cursed charm, or affection curdles into dangerous obsession.

 RETELL THE FAIRYTALES
 The...

store.name: Hell Express
store.short: Hell Express is a PVE Co-op isometric shooter for 1-4 players. As a member of an armed delivery company operating between the living world and Limbo, you'll craft, loot, and fight to complete high-stakes deliveries—while uncovering the stories between life and death.
store.about:
Hell Express is a PvE isometric extraction shooter for 1-4 players, blending heart-pounding combat, high-risk treasure hunts, and strategic resource management in a world teetering between life and death.
 As a member of Hell Express—an armed delivery company that sends delivery to Limbo—you'll choose from a diverse cast of characters, each with unique abilities and personal motives. Dive into the perilous depths of Limbo, complete dangerous deliveries, and scavenge for treasures to upgrade your gear and vehicles. But beware: every decision could mean the difference between survival and ruin.

 Key Features 
 A high-stakes isometric extraction shooter: Intense combat, balanced tactical raids, resource gambles, and precision extraction timing under survival pressure.

 Gun customization system: Scavenge components to forge gear that defines your playstyle.

 A road trip adventure: Freely explore limbo with an armed and custom Hell Trekker.

 Unique art style & dark humor: Tell stories that grip your heart, explore life, death, and what lies between.

store.name: Where Winds Meet
store.short: Step into an open-world action-adventure RPG set in ancient China. Uncover the secrets of your own identity as you rise from a humble village wanderer to the sword master of the imperial capital. Learn martial arts and build your reputation as a hero or a bringer of chaos in this free wuxia world.
store.about:
Jianghu knows no bounds. Play free across XBOX, PS5, PC, and mobile with full cross-play and cross-progression. No pay-to-win. 
 Gameplay content is entirely free, with monetization limited to cosmetic items. 
 In Where Winds Meet, Chinese martial arts meet a seamless open world. Roam vast landscapes, uncover hidden ruins, and descend into layered underground catacombs. Steal techniques from martial sects, wield an arsenal of classic wuxia weaponry, and master over 30 mystic arts – from the flowing balance of Tai Chi to the force of Lion's Roar.
 Craft, architecture, astronomy, folk games and performance, medicine and healing – 16 systems come together to form an immersive ancient society.

 A Living Open-World History 
 Jianghu knows no bounds.
 Ancient landscapes, traditional crafts, stories drawn from history and realistic graphics come together to build a world true to the spirit of wuxia.
 Immerse yourself in the captivating Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms period of China, where epic battles and legendary tales shape the course of history. From the bustling imperial capital to the hidden wilderness, every path is filled with secrets and adventures.
 Traverse vast landscapes in wuxia style: scale rooftops with fluid parkour, ride the windstride across miles in moments, or use fast travel points to leap between regions.

 Adventure Alone or Forge Your Community 
 Embark on a narrative-driven adventure filled with rich solo gameplay, or team up with up to four friends for seamless co-op experiences.
 Join or create a Guild to access group activities: intense guild wars,...

store.name: Darkhaven
store.short: Darkhaven is a next-generation ARPG brought to you by many of the original creators of Diablo and Diablo II. Explore a procedurally generated and fully destructible open world unlike any other in this solo or multiplayer adventure.
store.about:
Darkhaven is a dark-fantasy isometric ARPG set in the aftermath of a total collapse of civilization. You are a survivor in a world where the wild lands and monsters have reclaimed the ruins of long-dead empires. To survive, you must venture beyond the safety of your meager stronghold to hunt the remnants of evil and become the hero this world awaits. Unearth items of legendary power, learn arcane skill trees, and master a combat system that rewards skill and positioning over simple stat-checks.

 Every Player’s Game is Unique 

 Darkhaven moves away from the disconnected, "hallway-and-room" logic of traditional random layouts. We use ecological rules to stitch together biomes, handcrafted points of interest, and terrain that make sense. Every world is unique, yet feels cohesive with a rich implied history. Exploration isn't just a path to the next set of mobs; it’s the discovery of a vast and living realm.

 Totally Dynamic Worlds 
 The terrain in Darkhaven is fully deformable. You can dig into the earth to harvest resources, discover hidden caves, tunnel through dungeon walls, or rebuild ruined fortresses. Drain lakes to uncover sunken ruins or redirect flows of lava to form an impassable moat. You can also build. Raise the earth to create islands, fortify defensive positions, and construct everything from bridges to entire settlements. The land is your dominion, and its destiny is in your hands. 

 Lurking Horrors  
 Malevolent forces prey on the remains of this dying realm. Tendrils of darkness worm through the veil from other planes, tearing open rifts in reality. Each...

store.name: Cozy Game Restoration
store.short: Cozy Game Restoration is a soothing simulator where you gently bring forgotten video game cartridges back to life. Tear wrapping paper, peel old stickers, lift away grime, and transform dusty relics into cherished collectibles. No pressure or failure, just the quiet joy of restoring memories.
store.about:
Cozy Game Restoration is about the quiet satisfaction of restoring something that matters. You’ll unwrap carefully sealed packages to discover old, battered video game cartridges. They'll be covered in stickers, markers, dust, and all the accumulation of time. Each one is different, flawed in its own way, and waiting to be brought back to life.

 RESTORE FORGOTTEN RETRO GAMES 
 Every cartridge is procedurally dirtied. Some have clean labels but cracked shells. Others are scuffed, drawn on, or covered in adhesive residue. Grime is layered. Dust, ink, discoloration, stickers, and scratches each require a different tool to remove. Surfaces stretch, smear, and lift as you work. It’s slow, tactile, and satisfying.

 LOOT BOXES BUT IN A GOOD WAY 
 Game cartridges will arrive inside mystery parcels sealed with tape. You’ll peel them open by hand, lifting the flaps, and wrestling with sticky tape to see what’s inside. Each game has randomized conditions and visuals, with 108 distinct titles inspired by classics from the 1980s to early 2000s.

 Some are common finds, but others can be much rarer. You’ll encounter regional variants of carts, sticker artwork, and even shells made of gold (or better). Every game you restore will bring you closer to completing your collection, and there’s always a chance something unexpected will show up.

 COMPLETE YOUR COLLECTION 
 As you restore games, you’ll complete collection-based quests. This might be simple stuff like “collect three puzzle games”, or “two rare platformers”, but you’ll also see more unique things which work with the game’s...

store.name: OKU
store.short: Without art, our world is fading. As the lone apprentice to a vanished haiku master, you venture out into Japanese landscapes and capture their beauty in poetry to restore forgotten paths. Explore your legacy, meet other travelers on this meditative journey, and learn to appreciate art and nature.
store.about:
A Journey of Legacy and Loss 
 Become a traveling monk and follow in the footsteps of your departed Sensei, who set out on a final pilgrimage to restore a fading world.
 With little guidance, you inherit not only his path, but also the responsibility he left behind.
 In a world shaped by art and nature, something has begun to fade. Places once full of meaning lie abandoned, paths are sealed, and fewer people remain to remember what once was. The silence is not empty; it is filled with absence.
 As you travel through shifting seasons, you slowly begin to understand what has happened, and what it now means to carry this legacy forward.

 A World of Tradition 
 In this world, art is not decoration. It is connection.
 Poetry, music, ikebana, and tea ceremony are ways in which people preserve the relationship between humanity and nature. Yet something has begun to fade. Places are forgotten, paths are sealed, and traditions that once connected the world are slowly disappearing.
 As you journey onward, you will encounter fellow disciples and mysterious wanderers, each carrying their own stories, struggles, and relationship with the world around them.

 Poetry Shapes the World 
 Your words shape your journey.
 By observing your surroundings, you gather inspiration and form haiku-like poems that reflect what you see and feel. Through this act of expression, you will unlock hidden paths, open new areas, and restore forgotten places by giving them meaning once more.
 Your journey also becomes part of something larger.
 You will encounter poems left behind by other players, subtle...

store.name: ScopeCreep
store.short: A whispering flame craves souls. With each offering, your resolve strengthens. Fight spirits, collect their essences, and feed a hunger that may never subside in this short active incremental.
store.about:
Fight wandering spirits and harvest their essences. 

 Delve deeper into the void with unique upgrades. 

 Uncover the secrets buried in the shadows. 

 Features
 Vast upgrade system

 Simple, addicting combat

 Moody, ambient soundtrack

 Short active incremental

 Scope Creep

store.name: Ridiculous Space Battles
store.short: RIDICULOUS SPACE BATTLES is the spiritual successor to the first ever autobattler game: Gratuitous Space Battles! After a fifteen year wait, the ridiculously over-the-top and completely unjustified battles in space ARE BACK.
store.about:
RIDICULOUS SPACE BATTLES is the spiritual successor to the first ever autobattler game: Gratuitous Space Battles! After a fifteen year wait, the ridiculously over-the-top and completely unjustified battles in space ARE BACK.
 A completely new game, developed from scratch but inspired by the original, Ridiculous Space Battles hopes to truly live up to its name. Enjoy putting together increasingly huge wastes of galactic taxpayers money to build truly huge fleets of awesome space battleships to fight (for reasons unspecified) over vague patches of empty space against a range of despicable aliens who are (for reasons unspecified) our sworn enemies!

 There are a number of significant differences between Ridiculous Space Battles and its now ancient predecessor. Firstly the player now places ships onto a fixed grid. No more fiddling with the mouse trying to get neat formations! And ships are placed now in fixed sized squadrons. 1 Cruiser (huge!) or 4 Frigates (big!) or 25 fighters (tiny). 

 However RSB still has orders! Oh yes. There are a number of orders that determine how close to move the formation to the enemy, which ships to target, and under what circumstances ship should open fire. Utilize cunning formation and order combinations to take down enemy shields, then armor, then destroy the hull!
 Final victory is declared when all the ships on one fleet are destroyed or have escaped. The fleet with the largest total value of escaped or surviving ships is the victor!

 RSB is a game about spectacle and insanely large space battles. We will not bore you with 100 tutorial...

store.name: Hope in the City
store.short: 17-year-old Hope Song thought the national exams were her biggest worry... until she got home to a ransacked apartment and two missing parents. Investigate through the eyes of an artist, turn sketches into evidence, and watch her family's mystery grow stranger and darker with every answer.
store.about:
Your sketches may be the only clues you have. Play as 17-year-old Hope Song in this narrative mystery set in Shenyang, China. While everyone around her cracks under exam pressure, Hope escapes into her drawings, until her parents disappear. Investigate what happened, connect the clues, and uncover the truth hidden beneath the city's calm.

 You come home from school like any other day. But the house is quiet. Your parents are gone, the apartment is in shambles. No note, no warning, no answers.

 Hope isn't a detective. And everyone she turns to seems intent on avoiding trouble. But with an artist's eye, she notices details others overlook, and that's what makes her dangerous to whoever's hiding the truth. Drawing is no longer an escape; it's her best chance to solve her parents' mystery. 

 Wherever Hope goes and whoever she speaks with, she finds elements that don't add up. Investigate each one and capture your observations as sketches in Hope's notebook. Every detail matters.

 Combine Hope's sketches into insights, and keep adding new thoughts until they grow into breakthroughs. Piece by piece, sketch by sketch, watch the picture of what happened to your parents take shape, and grow darker than you ever imagined.

 Shenyang isn't just a backdrop, it's a character of its own. Rendered in a bold, stylized art style with an edge, every street, storefront, and shadowed alley is begging to be explored. Wander past neon signs and quiet corners, and let the city's striking visuals pull you deeper into its secrets.

 On the surface, it's just home: familiar streets, quiet...

store.name: Pal♡world! ~More Than Just Pals~
store.short: What lies inside the mysterious World Tree? An exciting school life filled with cute Pals! Will you remain friends or fall in love? Or dismantle and eat them...🍴 Your dream school romance starts here in this Palworld dating sim!
store.about:
This game contains horror elements. Please take care if you are sensitive to such content. 

 Located at the foot of the World Tree stands the prestigious Private Palpagos Academy!
 Starting today, you are a transfer student at this school.

 Will you make friends, become lovers… or—dismantle and eat them?
 Your relationships with the Pals are entirely up to you!

 Chat with your friends (Pals) and get to know them to grow closer!
 If conversations go well, your relationship might become something more than friendship…?

 At times, things may get a little heavy…

 Even if you make the wrong choice during conversations, don’t worry!
 Your friends (Pals) will surely forgive you, because they love you so much!
 At this academy filled with dreams and hope, meet a colorful cast of friends (Pals) and carve out an irreplaceable page of your youth!

 He…lp… me…

store.name: DREADMOOR
store.short: DREADMOOR is a dark first-person fishing adventure game set in a submerged world, rotting from a past catastrophe. Fish in murky waters, upgrade your boat, craft survival gear, and fight monstrous creatures that lurk under the water and on the land.
store.about:
DREADMOOR is an atmospheric first-person fishing adventure game set in a flooded world. Skill-based fishing, survival crafting, real-time combat, and exploration through rotting wetlands define your journey across land claimed by sea and decay.

 Take the helm of a fishing trawler and explore a world flooded by a catastrophic human mistake. Coastal regions have sunk beneath the water, and much of the remaining land has been submerged underwater. Travel between scattered settlements, catch fish to trade, upgrade your vessel, and craft essential equipment. Face mutated creatures across sea and land and move carefully through a divided world where resources are scarce, and trust is fragile.

 Dozens of dangerous and rare species await beneath the surface. Scour the waters for the best fishing spots, experiment with different baits, and compete with the unpredictable forces of nature as you cast your line into the murky waters. Sort your catch and keep an eye on the hold. Sea creatures do not hesitate to devour each other. The more dangerous the prey, the higher the price offered by the mysterious traders of the Submerged Lands.
 Seek out valuable resources along the way. In the Submerged Lands, scrap metal and forgotten blueprints are often worth their weight in gold. Explore abandoned buildings, caves, and shipwrecks in search of rare and useful finds.

 Resources gathered across the Submerged Lands can be crafted into specialized bait, reinforced harpoons, rare medicines, and survival tools suited to the harsh realities of this world. Discover new recipes, refine your...

store.name: Sea of Remnants
store.short: Sea of Remnants is a visually rich ocean adventure RPG. As a puppetfolk sailor seeking lost memories, you’ll brave dynamic seas, battle strange monsters, build your fleet, bond with companions, and shape the evolving pirate city of Orbtopia through every choice you make.
store.about:
Legend says that beyond the moon lies another sea—a place where all questions are answered.
 When the sailor opens their eyes once more, will they see a glass bottle floating in magenta currents, or the butterfly that once perched on a rusted mast?
 In Sea of Remnants, you play as an amnesiac sailor who sets out on a strange and wondrous ocean voyage alongside R.S, a girl whose identity is shrouded in mystery, in search of your lost memories.

 A Ship of Stubborn Souls 
 No sailor sets out without hoping to reach the Sea of Remnants.

 As Captain, recruit a diverse crew of puppetfolk and assemble a combat team of up to four, making the most of each member's strengths. 
 Collect cannons and ship parts yourself, then build a vessel tailored to your needs and brave the open sea. 
 A Forgotten Voyage 
 Rewards Each Voyage: Set Sail, Explore, Collect, Return
 The gear, old coins, Sea Shanties, and Enhancement Dice you gather along the way help your crew grow stronger with every voyage. Master strategic team-building to unleash explosive bursts of damage and watch those numbers soar.

 Long-Term Progression
 At the end of each week's voyage, your spoils are converted into Big Face Coins, a universal currency. Spend them in Orbtopia to develop your crew, unlock core classes, and assemble your ultimate team for the final chapter.

 Orbtopia: A Pirate's Safe Haven 
 As multiplayer adventures gradually roll out after global launch, explore a vast, whimsical world of puppetfolk and cross paths with fellow Captains from around the world.

 Orbtopia is the liveliest pirate city on the...

store.name: NebulArena
store.short: Build, customize, and unleash your ultimate space platform in NebulArena, a fast-paced, fully automated PvP arena where strategy, design, and destruction collide!
store.about:
Nebularena immerses you in futuristic PvP battles on space platforms, completely automated through your strategy. You will create the ultimate ship that will confront the constructions of other players in deathmatches where anything goes... 

 Build your ultimate structure. 

 Let your imagination merge with your best strategy and shape the perfect space platform. Massive, compact, agile, or aggressive — the design of your ship will have a decisive impact in battle.

 Dominate in automated battles and climb the Arena ladder. 

 Face off against other players’ space platforms in intense deathmatches where every strategy is fair game. Collisions, impacts, explosions, shockwaves, gunfire — enjoy the spectacle of fully automated combat!

 Unleash a powerful arsenal and choose your tech path. 

 Customize your tactics by picking from 4 main Cores, each unlocking dozens of buildings with unique functions:
 Attack towers (machine guns, flamethrowers, shotguns…)

 Robot factories (offensive, repair, or defensive bots)

 Command towers (ship movement and speed, ramming, evasion…)

 Master spatial balance. 

 Set-up your movement strategy: rush your adversary with spikes or try to avoid projectiles!
 develop and compose through various technologies. Mix liquid fire weapons with plasma shields!

 your core, your playstyle! Choose a true slow bulkwark, or a fast pace energy generator!

 Stack the bonuses: check on the technoogy tree for passives; and stack bonuses through item's rarity, and modules!

 Stay sharp and manage the key parameters of a competitive platform: energy, weight,...

store.name: Wyldheart
store.short: Embark on bite-sized campaigns in this co-op action RPG set in a rustic fantasy world. Start from nothing, and freely build your character as you investigate rumors, explore strange ruins, and survive the dangers threatening the fallen Kingdom of Caerwyn.
store.about:
YOU ARE NOT THE CHOSEN ONE 
 Start as a humble peasant tossed into a dungeon, tasked with finding one of the ancient Relics of Caerwyn to protect your town. Choose to be a proud Freefolk, a little Mossling, a towering Grimhorn or a stout Stonefolk, with 19 backgrounds and hundreds of customisation options to choose from!
 CUSTOMIZE YOUR COMBAT STYLE 
 Quickly swap between melee and ranged weapons, casting spells, or throwing deadly concoctions during immersive, fast-paced action combat. Classless, fully flexible skill trees in Adventuring, Survival, Dungeoneering, Weaponry and the Oldways of Magic allow you to specialize or create clever combinations.

 HANG OUT IN HANDCRAFTED TOWNS 
 Meet local villagers who all have lives, stories and schedules of their own. Reveal quests by eavesdropping, deciphering rumors, and exploring strange ruins. Gather materials, craft items, cook meals for your party, and upgrade your gear before continuing your adventure!

 SCHEDULING GAME NIGHT HAS NEVER BEEN EASIER 
 Play solo, or up to 4-player co-op with seamless drop-in/drop-out. Cloud-shared saves, group XP, and scaling difficulty all mean the party can continue with someone offline, but nobody gets left behind. Designed for busy gamers, campaigns have about 10 hours of story, and 15 hours of optional content.

 LOVINGLY CRAFTED BY A SMALL INDIE TEAM 
 Wyldheart is currently in Alpha, and we’re aiming to get it ready for Early Access later this year. If you’d like to stay updated on our release, you can Wishlist now or follow us at @wyldheartgame on most social networks.

store.name: Crop
store.short: A gritty farming thriller where your safety depends on the yield. Bound to a dying farm, you must dig, plant, irrigate, and cut your way through the decay. Uncover buried secrets, both in the soil and quietly brewing within the village. The only way out is through the harvest.
store.about:
Crop pairs methodical high-stakes farming with the slow-burning dread of an investigative thriller. Constrained to a fading homestead, you must feed a village on the brink of starvation. Master the routine, or surrender to the rot.

 You didn't inherit this land - the land claimed you. Now, the farm is your reality, and how you organise it is your only remaining freedom. With a desperate town relying on your yield, you must organise your crops wisely. Dig trenches, install pumps, and repair crumbling equipment to squeeze every drop of life from the dirt.

 The small town is severed from the world, and its survival rests in your unprepared hands. The odds are stacked against you: the farm is in a state of decay, choked by the clutter of the previous owner. Cut through waist-high grass to prevent pests, produce compost to improve the quality of crops, and meticulously prepare your plots. Whether you’re wearing a raincoat to endure a punishing storm or placing scarecrows against flocks of birds, every ditch dug and pesticide sprayed is a choice. The work is heavy, but in a world this broken, only tireless effort will move you forward.

 Your duties don't end at digging dirt. Why were you brought here? Why is the town cut off from the world? And who is watching from the shadows as dusk falls? Investigation is as vital as irrigation. Balance the toil of the fields with the hunt for answers. Every crop you harvest might buy the townsfolk another day of life, but every secret you unearth brings you closer to the truth.

 Navigate the stillness of the fields as the sun sets, and...

store.name: Frostpunk: 1886
store.short: A full reimagining of Frostpunk, the groundbreaking survival city builder, packed with new content. In a world ravaged by endless frost, become the Captain of the last city on Earth. Manage its people and infrastructure while facing cruel weather and even crueler choices.
store.about:
Frostpunk 1886 introduces new content and visuals while staying true to the legacy of the original Frostpunk, sticking to its premise and unique gameplay feel.
 Features:
 A completely new Purpose Path (in addition to Faith and Order)

 New explorable areas promising unique discoveries and hidden stories from the Frostlands

 New events, mechanics, laws, technologies, and buildings

 Full mod support

 Close-up view of your citizens paired with wider views of the city

 Several QoL features

 See New London with new eyes. Play through the original Frostpunk scenarios in fresh new ways, thanks to the wealth of additional content. You’ll face new challenges, employ different strategies, and discover unexpected truths about the world of Frostpunk… and yourself.
 Witness your people’s personal stories in unprecedented detail by bringing the camera closer to the struggle. In Frostpunk 1886, the experience is more intimate and immersive than ever before.
 With the game being rebuilt in a new engine, mods are finally coming to further extend and customize your playthroughs. It’s the perfect platform for all the wild mods, stories, and moral quandaries that the Frostpunk community is already eager to unleash.

 As Captain, you must protect humanity’s last bastion by managing a community built around the Generator, the city's only source of life-saving heat. Establish laws that regulate the existence of your growing society. Decide on their working routine, free time, food provision, and other crucial aspects of everyday life. Optimization and resource management must often clash...

store.name: Ghost Hunting Journal
store.short: Ghost Hunting Journal is an anime-style narrative adventure game. Follow a duo of self-proclaimed “Spirit Agents” as they take on supernatural cases, use a range of ghost-hunting techniques, and investigate urban legends surrounding the lingering spirits of Riverrun.
store.about:
Ghost Hunting Journal is a story-driven adventure game set in Riverrun, a fictional metropolis in China. 
 The protagonists are an unusual pair of paranormal agents. Despite their completely opposite personalities, they work together with remarkable chemistry, each possessing their own unique abilities. They specialize in taking on all kinds of supernatural cases. 
 Throughout the game, players will switch between the two protagonists and embark on a one-of-a-kind ghost-hunting adventure filled with terrifying screams, playful banter, and unexpected encounters. 

 After death, souls are supposed to be collected by Heaven and given the opportunity to enter the cycle of reincarnation. However, some souls remain bound by the obsessions they held in life, choosing to abandon reincarnation and linger in the human world. 
 These spirits are known as “Stubborn Souls.” Most remain unnoticed by the living, but a few make their presence known, giving rise to paranormal stories and urban legends. 

This ghost-hunting story is told through an exaggerated and playful anime-inspired style. 
 The characters are not simply there to scare you. Each has their own personality, emotions, personal struggles, and comedic quirks, bringing a little more absurdity (and a little more humanity) to every supernatural incident. 

 Players will switch between the two protagonists. 
 They possess different abilities and approach problems in different ways. You will need to make use of their strengths during investigations, conversations, and action sequences, helping them work together to complete a...

store.name: Armatus
store.short: ARMATUS is a third-person roguelite shooter set in the demon-infested ruins of Paris. As the last supernatural warrior of an ancient order, armed with powerful firearms and incredible celestial powers, scour the city in search of a lost gateway to heaven - the Sunless Gate.
store.about:
ARMATUS is a third-person roguelite shooter set in the demon-infested ruins of Paris. As the last supernatural warrior of an ancient order, armed with powerful firearms and incredible celestial powers, scour the city in search of a lost gateway to heaven - the Sunless Gate.
 HUMANITY’S TIME IS OVER
 The world has ended. Demons overrun once busy streets as reality unravels. Collapse is inevitable. Sequestered behind holy wards, the last survivors believe themselves the only humans left alive. Their only hope is for you to carve a path through the chaos and find their salvation. But the broken pieces of Paris give way to increasingly demonic hellscapes inhabited by ever stronger and more grotesque monsters.

 FIGHT. DIE. REPEAT.
 Knowledge is a weapon, and death is never the end. Each run, wield your scythe and a gun of your choosing against brutal demons hellbent on your destruction. To overcome them, evolve your combat style with powerful celestial abilities and passive enhancements. Die and you will revive to fight again. 
 Fight, die, revive, and try again; Push forward to get farther each run and master your arsenal.

 START STRONG, END GODLY
 From the moment you step into the ruins, you are heavily armed and powerful. Yet you will keep gaining new powers until you have the tools to lay waste to your enemies. Find your favorite lethal combination of guns and powers, from SMGs and shotguns to holy fire and slow time, to truly obliterate everything standing in your way.
 Will you grow strong enough to defeat the horrors of the Scoured Path?

store.name: Guildrun
store.short: Build a simple team into an unstoppable force and crush waves of monsters in this PvE autobattler roguelike. No two runs feel the same as you make each hero your own with countless combinations and synergies to discover. Play at your own pace, get creative and take risks to beat the rifts.
store.about:
Rifts have torn open in cities across the world, and no one knows what's driving them. You are tasked with building a guild of unique heroes, level them up to crazy power spikes and combine their abilities with items and relics to break the game and unveil the unknown cause of the rift crisis.

 Adapt each run as different things are offered to you. With infinite build freedom without a PvP meta that would force certain strategies, every run feels like a new puzzle. As you learn the depth of options available you’ll become an expert at pivoting mid-run, reshaping any makeshift team into an unstoppable force.

 Every hero has their starting class and ability, but you choose where they end. With over 500 unique ways to level up and shape each hero, get creative and turn a backline healer into a frontline tank or a ranged dps into a melee brawler. Or, pair two lovers on the battlefield for rapid scaling bonuses.

 Unlock Heroes, items and relics.  Run-by-run, unlock new heroes, relics and items to discover 25 heroes, 180 specializations, 300+ relics and 100+ items in the demo alone.

 Play on your clock . No timer, no queue, no PvP. Think as long as you want, save mid-run, and come back when life lets you.

 Break every hero out of their class . 25 heroes across 75 spec paths, and a modifier pool that stacks across classes. Draft, level, respec, and build unfair comps.

 Progress through 8 difficulties . Every successful run unlocks a harder challenge for the next. Stack fresh modifiers to climb up the difficulty ladder, then hit Endless mode to chase the top of the global...

store.name: Warhammer Survivors
store.short: Warhammer Survivors is the official grim and dark bullet-heaven game from the developers of Warhammer 40,000 Boltgun. Play as over 40 iconic champions from the Warhammer 40,000 and Warhammer Age of Sigmar universes and obliterate those who champion death and destruction.
store.about:
The addictive bullet-heaven action of the survivors genre comes to the 41st Millennium and the Mortal Realms in an officially licensed game from Auroch Digital (Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun) in partnership with Warhammer and poncle (Vampire Survivors). 

Experience Warhammer’s epic champions, enemies, weapons and more, meticulously handcrafted in animated pixel glory. 

 - Frenetic Bullet Heaven survival in a grim dark setting 
- Over 40 iconic playable characters from the Warhammer 40,000 and Warhammer Age of Sigmar universes, featuring Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun’s very own Malum Caedo! 
- Multiple modes and stages from across the grim, dark 41st Millennium and the Mortal Realms.  
- An arsenal of 75+ weapons, such as the Boltgun, Astartes Chainsword, Whirlwind Axes and easter eggs such as the humble pot of Nuln Oil.  
- Face down the mightiest monsters the universes have to offer, including the disgustingly bloated Great Unclean One. Extremis Bosses pose a challenge even for Survivors-like veterans! 
- A mighty cache of passives and power-ups to aid in enduring against the monstrous legions.  
- Esoteric secrets to uncover and collectables to collect!  
- ...and more! 

 Choose your universe and become a legend of the Imperium or champion of Order in frenetic battles across the open and ashen plains of Aqshy to the tight and confined corridors of an abandoned Space Hulk. Every stage is a new arena of slaughter, each with its own enemy faction... and secrets to uncover. 

 Unlock and choose from over 40 of your favorite characters from both the Warhammer 40,000 and Warhammer...

store.name: CONTROL Resonant
store.short: Explore a warped Manhattan on the brink of paranatural annihilation in this thrilling action-adventure RPG. Unleash the extraordinary powers of Dylan Faden as he fights for his humanity and our survival against a reality-bending cosmic threat.
store.about:
After years in confinement at the hands of the Federal Bureau of Control (FBC), Dylan Faden emerges into a warped Manhattan at the peak of a paranatural crisis. 

 Charged with combating a mysterious cosmic entity as it alters fundamental aspects of our reality, Dylan must harness his new-found powers to take the fight to the myriad threats overwhelming Manhattan. 

 Join Dylan in this sequel to the multi-award-winning CONTROL to explore the expansive zones of a city overrun by the corrupting influences of the chaotic Hiss, invasive micro-organism, the Mold, and other twisted paranatural threats. 

 On the path to unlocking the full potential of his paranatural abilities Dylan will also seek out his sister, FBC Director Jesse Faden, as he bids to comprehend and contain the dangers that have spilled beyond the confines of the Oldest House to tear our world apart. 
 STEP INTO A WARPED REALITY    
 Explore multiple areas of a ravaged Manhattan in an expansive, unfamiliar, and exciting world.  

Traverse perception-bending locations and grapple with gravity anomalies that distort the vertical and horizontal plane, adding additional dimensions to puzzles and new tactical decisions to combat.  

Meet faces old and new on a path fraught with risk but rich in opportunity as the cityscape is reshaped and reality is redefined by a godlike force.

 MASTER THE PARANATURAL  
 Channel the raw experiences of Dylan’s past to help understand his present and dig deeper into the inner workings of the FBC and reveal the horrors threatening humankind. 

Tap into power he must learn to master...

store.name: HABROMANIA
store.short: A dreamy Alice in Wonderland-inspired RPG that follows 19-year-old Alice as she tries to escape the surreal, cozy hellscape that is Wonderland—hopefully with her sanity intact.
store.about:
Alice must have been falling for at least an hour. Or maybe longer- Alice has never been very good at keeping time. But the wind rushes in her hair, yanking at her clothes, and it's almost like she's flying. It's glorious. 
 Until she hits the ground. 

 HABROMANIA is a dreamy (or nightmarish) Alice in Wonderland-inspired RPG that follows 19-year-old Alice as she tries to escape the surreal, cozy hellscape that is Wonderland—hopefully with her sanity intact. Alice wakes up at the bottom of a hole with a pounding headache and no memories of how she landed there- or memories in general, actually. 

 She can't remember her past, but she knows that she needs to get out of here, wherever here is. Guide Alice as she attempts to escape Wonderland, navigating lush, hand-drawn environments and the socially incompetent characters who inhabit them, all with their own complex pasts and varied moral compasses.

 Explore  immersive, maximalist environments jam-packed with interactables and collectibles, accompanied by an original OST played on an out-of-tune piano

 Make Choices through branching dialogue and a karma system that determines the fate of the creatures of Wonderland and Alice herself,

 Collect Very Interesting And Useful things  that aid in puzzle-solving, bartering, and uncovering the deeper lore of Wonderland and the people there

 Uncover the past  and the truth about Wonderland before Alice loses her head (or her mind)

 HABROMANIA is a narrative-driven game with 12 "chapters" and multiple endings. Chapters will be released continuously with game updates. 

 and...

store.name: TBH: Task Bar Hero
store.short: The ultimate tiny idle RPG! Adorable pixel heroes are waiting to join your adventure — from your taskbar. Fight off the boredom of work and daily life with diverse classes, skills, items, and builds!
store.about:
《TBH: Task Bar Hero》   is the ultimate tiny idle RPG that fits right into your taskbar. 
 Just leave it running on your screen — your pixel heroes will automatically gather loot and grow stronger on their own.
 Explore diverse regions, level up your characters and gear, build your own strategies, and take down waves of monsters!

 ■ Small But Mighty RPG 
 - A full hack-and-slash RPG experience packed into a tiny window.
 - Mix and match classes, items, and skills to craft your own unique build.
 - Use the Cube System to add and customize stats on your items.
 - 3 Acts and 4 difficulty tiers, each filled with a variety of monsters to defeat.

 ■ Play Anytime — Even During Work 
 - Your adventure keeps going automatically, even when you're away.
 - Simple controls make it easy to pick up and play for as long as you like.
 - Lightweight design lets it run comfortably alongside other programs.

 ■  Key Features 
 - 500+ unique items
 - 50+ monster types
 - 50+ unlockable achievements
 - Items freely tradeable on the Steam Market
 - A loot system with rarities ranging from Common, Uncommon, Rare, and Legendary, all the way up to Immortal, Arcana, Beyond, Celestial, Divine, and Cosmic

store.name: Mortuus
store.short: A round-based co-op zombies FPS for 1 to 4 players. Survive endless hordes in brutalist procedurally generated map. Buy doors, hit the mystery box, upgrade your guns, and uncover the hidden ritual that wakes the Mother.
store.about:
Mortuus is a round-based zombies FPS for 1 to 4 players. Survive the round, spend your points, choose your upgrade and last as long as you can. The rules are familar but the map is not. 
Every run builds a new procedurally generated map, so the doors, the perk machines, the mystery box and the way out are never where they were last time. Play solo or with friends

 No run starts on a layout you have memorized. Rooms, corridors, courtyards and dead ends are rebuilt each time, in daylight or at night, in clear weather or a storm. You learn the game, not the map.
